title: Phone Appointment Setter for US General Contractors (Roofers, Remodelers & More), Commission-Based, 3 Openings
description:
TITLE:

Friendly Phone Appointment Setter for US General Contractors (Roofers, Remodelers & More), Commission-Based, 3 Openings



HI THERE!

We're Piedmont Websites & Automations, a small company in Greensboro, NC. We help contractors stop losing jobs when they miss a call. Our service sends an automatic text right away, so the customer stays and the contractor gets the job. Learn more at 
.



We're hiring 3 friendly, reliable people to help us reach contractors by phone, and you won't be figuring things out alone.



WHO I AM

My name is Hassan, and I'm from Greensboro. I started Piedmont because I kept seeing great local businesses that nobody could find online. Good people doing good work. My background is in corporate IT, remote sales (including time learning high-ticket sales), and e-commerce, and today I build AI and automation tools for local businesses. My first client got their first inbound lead within 72 hours of launching, and that confirmed everything. I know what it's like to learn sales from the ground up, so I want this to be a role where you feel comfortable asking questions and growing.



THE ROLE

You'll call newly registered US general contractors (roofers, remodelers, and similar), mostly owner-operators and small crews. You'll have a friendly conversation, see if what we offer sounds helpful, and book a short call with me on our calendar. You don't close anything. I handle the demo and the sign-up.



A typical day:

- About 100 calls, five days a week

- If nobody picks up, call again, then send a short text from our template

- Book interested owners and log everything in our tracker



WHAT YOU GET

- A fresh, researched list of newly registered local general contractors, with owner names and numbers looked up wherever we can find them

- Sales training before you dial, plus a call script and answers to common questions

- A practice call with me, feedback on your calls, and a weekly check-in

- Our calling and tracking tools, a demo video to send to owners, and a small team chat



PAY

This is commission only, with no base pay:

- $20 for every booked call where the owner or decision maker joins for at least [10] minutes

- A $75 bonus when a client signs up and pays their first month

- Paid weekly through [PayPal / Wise]. Bonuses are paid once the client's first payment clears.



What to expect: with about 100 calls a day, five days a week, a typical rep can expect around 5 booked calls a week, about 3 attended, and 2 to 3 clients signing per month. That adds up to roughly $450 per month on target. This is a typical estimate, not a guarantee. Your first weeks will likely be lower while you learn the script, and your earnings can grow as you improve.



WHERE THIS CAN GROW

If you do great work, our goal is to add base pay and open roles like sales manager.



YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

- Have phone experience with US businesses (contractors or home services is a bonus)

- Speak clear, friendly English and can call during US hours ([9 AM to 5 PM Eastern])

- Have a quiet space, steady internet, and a headset



HOW TO APPLY

We'd love to hear from you! Please start your message with the word CALLS so we know you read this, then tell us:

1. What's your experience with phone calls to customers or businesses?

2. If a contractor says, "I'm on a job, can you just send me an
?", what would you say?

3. Are you comfortable with commission-based pay, and what hours work for you?



To finish, please record a short 15 to 30 second voice message reading this opener and share the link: "Hey, this is [Name]. I'll be upfront with you, this is a cold call. Would you like to hang up, or give me 30 seconds?"

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant – Car Rental Business



We are a growing private car rental company looking for a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Executive Assistant to help support the owner and keep daily operations running smoothly.



This is not just a basic admin position. We need someone who can stay on top of multiple moving parts, communicate with the team, follow up consistently, and make sure important tasks do not fall through the cracks.



## Responsibilities



You will assist with:



- Managing the CEO/owner’s daily task list and priorities

- Following up with team members to make sure tasks are completed

- Tracking rental vehicles, customers, payments, and maintenance updates

- Communicating with customer service staff, fleet operators, mechanics, and vendors

- Following up on vehicles currently at mechanic shops

- Identifying vehicles that are sitting and finding out why they are not rented

- Keeping spreadsheets, trackers, and internal records updated

- Scheduling meetings and calls

- Organizing documents, contracts, receipts, and business information

- Helping monitor customer issues and making sure they are handled properly

- Following up on insurance claims and other administrative matters when needed

- Preparing daily updates for the owner

- Helping create and improve SOPs and internal systems

- Handling other executive and administrative tasks as the company grows



## What We Are Looking For



We need someone who is:



- Extremely organized

- Reliable and punctual

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable following up with people repeatedly

- Able to communicate professionally in English

- Good at solving problems without needing constant supervision

- Comfortable working with Google Sheets, Google Docs,
,
, and online systems

- Able to manage several tasks at once

- Fast at responding

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced business

- Willing to take ownership of responsibilities



Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Operations Assistant, Customer Service Representative, or Administrative Assistant is preferred.



Experience with car rentals, transportation, logistics, fleet management, or similar businesses is a plus but not required.



## Work Schedule



40 hours per week



Monday–Friday



You must be available during our primary U.S. business hours and communicate consistently throughout your shift.



## Starting Pay



$4 USD per hour



There will be opportunities for increased responsibility, bonuses, and growth based on performance.



## What Success Looks Like



Your job is to help make sure the owner does not have to constantly chase people for updates.



At the end of each day, we should know:



- What vehicles are rented

- What vehicles are available

- What vehicles are in maintenance

- What mechanics are working on

- What customers need attention

- What payments or issues need follow-up

- What tasks were completed

- What still needs to be handled



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company long term.

“READY TO EXECUTE”



Applications without this phrase may not be reviewed.

All agreed-upon eligible products correctly published on Amazon.



Product variations configured accurately.

Inventory and fulfillment connections tested.

title: Staff Accountant / Bookkeeper – Xero, Dext, Hubdoc & Microsoft Office
description:
Sunrise Chartered Professional Accountant is seeking a detail-oriented Staff Accountant / Bookkeeper to support bookkeeping and accounting work for our clients. We are looking for someone with practical Xero experience, strong Microsoft Office skills, and the ability to process source documents accurately using Dext and Hubdoc.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintain accurate client books in Xero, including transaction coding, bank feeds, bank and credit card reconciliations, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Use Dext and Hubdoc to collect and organize receipts and invoices, verify extracted information against source documents, identify duplicates, and prepare transactions for review or publishing under our procedures.

• Check supplier names, dates, amounts, account coding, and sales tax treatment; flag missing documents or unclear items for review.

• Prepare monthly bookkeeping summaries, reconciliation schedules, and supporting working papers for accountant review.

• Use Microsoft Excel to organize and reconcile data, prepare schedules, and investigate differences. Use Word and Outlook for documentation, professional communication, and follow-up.

• Maintain organized digital records and follow client-specific procedures, deadlines, and confidentiality requirements.



CORE SKILLS

• Xero: hands-on experience with bank feeds, transaction matching, reconciliations, bills, invoices, and standard financial reports.

• Dext: experience processing receipts and invoices, reviewing extracted data, checking duplicates, and applying appropriate coding.

• Hubdoc: experience collecting and organizing source documents, checking captured details, and working with its Xero integration.

• Microsoft Office: strong Excel skills, including formulas, sorting and filtering, lookup functions, and PivotTables; comfortable using Word and Outlook.

• Solid understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and the ability to reconcile balances to supporting documents.

• Strong attention to detail, clear written English, reliable follow-through, and willingness to ask questions when information is incomplete.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience supporting multiple clients or an accounting firm.

• Experience with Canadian bookkeeping and GST/HST is an asset.

• Xero certification and an accounting-related degree or diploma are assets. Practical experience is highly valued.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. A short summary of your relevant bookkeeping and accounting experience.

2. Your hands-on experience with each of Xero, Dext, Hubdoc, and Microsoft Office, including Excel.

3. An example of a reconciliation issue you investigated and how you resolved it, without sharing confidential client information.

4. Your availability, preferred working hours, earliest start date, and expected compensation with currency.

5. Your resume and details of any relevant certifications.



Please use “Sunrise – Xero Bookkeeper” as the subject of your application.

• Problem-solving skills and the ability to address discrepancies effectively.

title: Finance & Executive Admin Assistant — Xero, GoHighLevel & AI
description:
# Finance & Executive Admin Assistant  

**Xero | Australian Bookkeeping | GoHighLevel | AI | Executive Support**



We are looking for a highly organised, detail-oriented **Finance & Executive Admin Assistant** to support an Australian/Singapore-based business.



This is a hybrid role combining **bookkeeping, finance administration, executive support and systems/CRM administration**.



We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of recurring tasks, keeping systems organised, following through without constant supervision, and helping improve how the business operates.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping & Finance Administration

- Maintain accurate bookkeeping in Xero

- Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

- Correctly code and categorise transactions

- Manage receipts and supporting documents using Hubdoc or similar systems

- Assist with supplier bills and expense management

- Maintain clean balance sheet accounts

- Assist with intercompany/entity reconciliations

- Prepare bookkeeping records for GST/BAS review

- Support catch-up bookkeeping where required

- Prepare monthly P&L and balance sheet reports

- Maintain Xero files in an accountant-ready condition

- Liaise with accountants/bookkeepers when required



Experience with **Australian bookkeeping, GST and BAS processes** is important.

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Content Repurposing Specialist (Retainer-Based)
description:
Job Overview:



We are a fast-growing digital agency based in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, specializing in helping local luxury real estate teams and boutique businesses scale their social media presence. We are looking for a creative, highly reliable, long-term Video Editor to join our team behind the scenes.

Your role is to take raw concept assets (scripts, stock footage, or unedited clips) and turn them into premium, high-retention 9:16 vertical videos.



Core Responsibilities (Job to be Done):



• Video Editing & Pacing: Cut down raw footage into highly engaging 15-to-60-second vertical videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts). Trim out awkward pauses, dead air, and filler words.

• Dynamic Subtitles: Generate and style clean, kinetic on-screen captions. Text must be perfectly synced with the pacing and feature high-end, premium fonts that align with a luxury brand identity.

• Visual Enhancements: Apply clean transitions, color correction, and intentional zoom cuts/punches to maintain viewer attention every 2 to 3 seconds.

• Audio Design: Source and layer trending, royalty-free background music and subtle sound effects (risers, swooshes, clicks) to maximize impact.

• Caption & Queue Management: Write a short, optimized caption for each video and schedule the finalized assets inside our social media pipeline (Metricool/Publer).



Compensation & Work Structure:



• This is a retainer-based, part-time position that scales with your output.

• We pay a flat retainer of $250 to $350 USD per month, per client account you manage.

title: Creative Copywriter + Storyteller for Short-Form Content
description:
Creative Copywriter + Storyteller for Short-Form Content



I’m looking for a seriously good writer.



Not someone who copies a prompt into ChatGPT and sends me whatever comes back.



I run multiple content brands and produce short-form content across Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube. Some of our content includes cinematic AI-generated videos, but the writing behind the content needs to feel HUMAN.



Real conversations.

Real emotion.

Good storytelling.

Strong hooks.

Characters people actually care about.

Copy that makes somebody stop scrolling.



You may be writing a dramatic 60-second scene one day, a funny carousel the next, and a promotional video the next.



I need someone who understands how people actually talk and knows how to turn a simple idea into content people want to watch.



 What you'll write



You may be responsible for:



• 30–90 second short-form video scripts  

• Episodic stories and recurring characters  

• Hooks and opening lines  

• Natural dialogue  

• Cliffhangers  

• Social media captions  

• Carousel copy  

• Promotional scripts  

• Story-based sales content  

• Content concepts and angles  

• Rewriting content to match different brand voices



You should be comfortable switching voices.



One brand may be dramatic and cinematic.



Another may be funny, conversational and relatable.



Another may need persuasive copy designed to generate leads or sales.



They should NOT all sound like the same writer.



 IMPORTANT: AI usage



We use AI in our business. I am not against AI.



However, I am specifically hiring you because I need a HUMAN writer.



AI can be used as a supporting tool for research, brainstorming or editing, but it should not be doing the creative thinking and writing for you.



If your normal process is:



Prompt ChatGPT → copy → lightly edit → submit



this position is not for you!



I can already do that myself.



I am looking for someone who has their own creative instincts, understands human behavior, can develop original ideas and can write dialogue that sounds like something real people would actually say.



How we will hire...



There will be multiple rounds.



Round 1 — Application



Send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Three writing samples you're proud of.

3. Tell me what type of writing you're BEST at.

4. Tell me what type of writing you struggle with.

5. Tell me honestly how you currently use AI in your writing process.



Do NOT send me a long formal cover letter.



Round 2 — Writing test



Selected applicants will receive a short writing assignment.



You may be asked to:



• Write a short dramatic scene.

• Rewrite bad/robotic copy so it sounds human.

• Create hooks from a basic idea.

• Write the same message for two completely different audiences.



The purpose isn't perfection.



I want to see how your brain works.



 Round 3 — Live writing session



Finalists may complete a short PAID live writing session.



Room for growth is possible as we expand.

title: Real Estate SMS Manager
description:
SMS Manager (Real Estate Acquisitions, Launch Control)



We run off-market Acquisitions in the United States and are hiring an SMS Manager to own our seller text outreach end to end. You will build and load lists, launch and pace campaigns in Launch Control and/or Smarter Contact, protect deliverability, and get qualified replies to the acquisitions team fast.



What you will own



Campaigns: Build, launch, schedule, and pace campaigns in Launch Control. Manage sending numbers, rotation, and campaign naming so results stay traceable.



Reply handling: Monitor inbound replies during your shift, respond using the approved qualification script, and route qualified sellers to acquisitions immediately. You will not improvise messaging or go off script.



Lists and data: Pull property and owner records in PropStream, run skip tracing, and deliver clean, deduplicated, correctly mapped upload files. Scrub DNC and prior opt outs before every send.



Deliverability: Track delivery rates, carrier filtering, and number health. Verify spintax and merge field syntax before launch. Flag drops in delivery before they cost us send volume.



Compliance: Maintain opt out and DNC records, follow TCPA and Florida FTSA requirements, and keep 10DLC registration details accurate.



Reporting: Daily numbers on sends, delivery rate, reply rate, qualified leads, and cost per qualified lead, with a short note on what changed and why.



Testing: Run controlled tests on approved message variants, segments, and send timing. One variable at a time. Report the result.



Targets you will be measured on



Delivery rate above 90 percent

Reply response time under 5 minutes during shift hours

Qualified leads per 1,000 sends, tracked and improving month over month

Zero compliance incidents

What this role is not



No outbound calls. No appointment setting. No negotiating price with sellers. Text execution and data only.



Requirements



Hands on experience running SMS campaigns in Launch Control and Smarter Contact. This is required and will be verified in a test task.

Working experience in PropStream or a comparable data platform, including polygon and filter based list pulls.

Skip tracing experience (KindSkiptracing, BatchSkipTracing, or similar).

Strong spreadsheet and data hygiene skills: deduplication, field mapping, formatting for upload.

Understanding of SMS deliverability: carrier filtering, number health, spintax, merge fields.

Written English strong enough to handle live seller replies without sounding scripted or foreign to a US reader.

Reliable overlap with 9am to 6pm US Eastern.

CRM experience, Salesforce preferred but not required.



$4-$5/hour, with an incentive program which will be based around response rates and conversion rates.

title: Paid Ads Operator
description:
Run paid campaigns for a US legal growth company and its law firm clients, with AI doing the volume work and you doing the judgment. Remote, full time, independent contractor.



The Company

Who you would be working for



My Legal Academy is a tech-forward growth infrastructure company for law firms, founded in 2019 and based in Los Angeles, California. We do not sell marketing services. We install and operate complete growth systems inside small US law firms: intake, CRM, follow-up automation and paid acquisition. We have worked with more than 2,000 firms, and the metric we are judged on is signed cases, not clicks.



That distinction matters for this role. A campaign that produces cheap leads nobody signs is a failed campaign here. You will be looking at cost per signed case as often as cost per lead.



The Role

What you would own



You will manage two campaign portfolios end to end with underlying support of AI platforms. You are not handing creative to a designer and media buying to a specialist. You are the person who takes a budget, a practice area and a market, and comes back with a campaign that works.



Internal Campaigns

My Legal Academy's own lead generation: paid social driving attorneys into our programs, plus webinar and program launch campaigns. You own budget allocation, creative, targeting and the numbers we review weekly, and you build the test plans with our marketing lead.



Client Campaigns

Meta ads for law firm clients across personal injury, estate planning, immigration, family and business law. Multiple accounts at once, each with its own market, budget and partner who wants to know where the money went.



Creative Production

Creating or assisting the team with ad concepts, hooks, copy, static and video creative, and the testing plan behind them. You generate variants at volume with AI, then apply taste to decide which ones run.



Funnels and Follow-up

Landing pages, lead magnets, forms and the GoHighLevel automations behind them. A lead that reaches a CRM and gets no follow-up is a lead we paid for and lost, so the funnel is part of the campaign and part of your job.



How we measure it

For My Legal Academy: cost per qualified attorney lead, webinar registrations, calls booked with sales, CAC, ROAS.

For clients: cost per qualified lead, consultations, signed cases, ROAS.

Underperforming campaigns raised early, with a fix attached.



The Differentiator

How we work with AI



This is the part of the job that is not standard, and the part we will screen hardest on. Our team runs on Claude. Not as a novelty and not as a copywriting shortcut, but as the default way work gets done. The people who do well here have restructured how they work around it.



In practice that means you build your own tooling instead of waiting for someone to build it for you. Set up Claude Projects with your account context so you are not re-explaining a client every session. Write prompts that produce forty ad variants worth reading, not four that need rewriting. Hand a spend export to Claude and get the analysis back in minutes instead of building the pivot table yourself. Draft the client performance summary, then edit it, instead of starting from a blank page. Use ranql, our competitive intelligence platform for law firm markets, to map each market and the ads competitors run.

We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone whose current output would drop by half if you took the tools away. If that describes you, the interview will be easy and you should apply.



What you get

Ownership of paid ads for My Legal Academy and for our law firm clients.

Claude and Claude Code as your daily tools, plus access to ranql.

Direct work with the CEO, Head of Growth, marketing lead and the client success team.

Pay: $9.50 to $11.50 an hour, full time (40 hours a week), paid twice a month.



Requirements

What you need to have



Experience: Two or more years running Meta campaigns with real budget. You have managed money that was not yours and reported on it to someone who cared.

AI Fluency: Genuine daily use, particularly with Claude, including maintaining your own prompt library and knowing what these tools are bad at. You will be asked to show your work.

Creative Range: Ability to write a hook and build a static creative that stops a scroll, using AI or other no-code tools.

Data and Metrics: Comfort with CPL, CPA, ROAS and cost per signed case, and the transparency to surface underperforming campaigns promptly.

Communication: Written English strong enough for copy aimed at US attorneys and performance summaries for partners.

Availability: Full overlap with US Pacific business hours.

Setup: Reliable workstation, stable internet with a backup connection and a quiet environment for client calls.



Strong Plus

Google Ads: Search campaigns with real budget.

GoHighLevel: Builder-level experience with sub-accounts, snapshots, workflows, pipelines and calendars.

Funnel Building: Landing pages across GHL, Webflow, Framer or custom builds.

US Legal Market: Prior experience in legal lead generation, particularly personal injury.

Video Editing: CapCut, Premiere, Descript or AI-assisted video production.

Technical AI: Claude Code, MCP servers or scripting for reporting automation.

Copywriting and CRO: Background in conversion copywriting or conversion rate optimization.



Not a Fit If

We would rather you self-select out now than discover it in week three.

You require a detailed brief before you can start executing.

Your experience is strictly limited to agency roles where others handled client relationships and budget management.

You use AI tools to generate content without editing or reviewing it yourself.

You intend to negotiate away working US Pacific hours after joining.

You plan to manage this alongside another full-time position.



How to apply

Send your resume to 
 candidates join a recorded video interview. Come ready to show, from your own past work:

Two Meta campaigns you ran, with the numbers before and after (screen share or exported reports, client names hidden).

The AI workflow behind them: the prompts, Claude Projects or scripts you used for research, creative and reporting.

Ads you wrote or built, which ones won and why.

One campaign that underperformed, what told you, and what you changed.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
What you get



Full ownership of My Legal Academy marketing: the channels, the calendar and the calls on what to keep and what to stop.

A direct line to the CEO, Head of Growth and CX Sr. Manager. You define the plan and execute it, watch how it performs and change course as soon as the results point the way.

Room to test new channels and drop the ones that don't move the number.

A team that already runs on Claude. You bring working Claude or AI platform skills and use them from day one.

Pay: $11 to $14 an hour, full time (40 hours a week), paid twice a month, plus a monthly bonus tied to the conversations you hand to sales.



About us

My Legal Academy helps US law firm owners grow their firms. We run live training (MLA AI Labs), coaching programs and growth systems for small firms. Your audience is law firm owners and their teams.



What you will own

New conversations for sales. Start real conversations with law firm owners who are new to us and hand them to our sales lead. A conversation is a reply, a DM thread or a booked call. A like or a view does not count.

Organic channels. Our newsletter, community and social pages. Decide what stays and what stops, and tell us why.

Outreach and communities. Reach law firm owners directly and in the places where they talk about growing their firms.

Content and webinars. Turn our leaders' expertise into posts and short video, and fill our webinars.

Paid tests. Plan them and run them with our paid ads operator.

Focus. Pick the few efforts most likely to bring results, go deep on them and double down on what works. We value focused, thorough work over a long list of activity.



What you decide on your own

When a channel or campaign is underperforming, and what to change.

When to stop something and where to put the time instead.

Which new idea to test next, and what result would prove it.

You don't wait for a brief. You look at the numbers, make the call and tell us what you changed and why.



How we measure it

Engaged conversations with new law firm owners handed to sales each month.

Webinar registrations from your outreach.

Results from a few focused efforts, pushed until they work.

How fast you spot a weak channel and what you do about it.



What you bring

Three or more years in marketing where you owned the results.

A record of stopping something that wasn't working and replacing it with something that did. Be ready to show the numbers.

Strong written English for US attorneys: posts, e-mails and outreach messages.

Comfort with numbers: reach, replies, click rates, registrations, cost per lead.

Experience with LinkedIn outreach,
 groups or community marketing.

A working, daily skill with Claude or another AI platform for research, writing and analysis. Be ready to show how you use it.

Clear communication with sales, paid ads and leadership, in writing and on calls.

Working hours that overlap with US Pacific business hours.

A plus: GoHighLevel, Canva or CapCut, short-form video editing and B2B or professional-services marketing.



How we work

Remote, with Slack for daily work and Zoom for calls.

We set the number together and you own how to reach it.

We review results together. Bring the numbers and your next move.

We tell one another early when something isn't working.



How to apply

Send your resume to 
 with short answers to these five questions:

Tell us about a channel or campaign you stopped on your own call. What did the numbers show, and what did you do with the time you freed up?

Tell us about a time you changed a plan halfway through without being asked. What told you it was off?

Name one number you owned in your last role. What was it when you started and when you left?

Your posts on one channel got high views and zero replies for two weeks. What do you do this week?

How do you use AI in your marketing work today? Give one example.

Preferred

 tools

title: Solar & Battery Compliance / Operations Officer – Australian Solar Industry
description:
# Solar & Battery Compliance & Operations Officer – Australian Solar Industry



**Company:** AusGreen Energy Group Pty Ltd  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Part-Time – 24 hours per week  

**Salary:** AUD $8–15 per hour (negotiable based on experience)



## About Us



AusGreen Energy Group is an Australian renewable energy company based in Sydney, NSW, specialising in residential and commercial solar PV systems, battery storage and electrical installations.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and proactive **Solar & Battery Compliance & Operations Officer** to manage installation administration, job coordination, compliance documentation and operational workflows.



The successful candidate will be responsible for progressing each job from the moment a customer accepts a proposal through to installation completion, compliance submission and customer handover.



Previous experience working with an Australian solar or battery installation company is strongly preferred.



**Candidates with additional experience in Meta Ads, digital marketing or website development will receive higher priority during the recruitment process.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Accepted Proposals – OpenSolar

- Review accepted customer proposals in OpenSolar.

- Verify customer details, installation address, system specifications and accepted scope.

- Check equipment details, pricing and payment terms.

- Identify missing information and escalate discrepancies to management.



### 2. Job Creation & Management – ClickUp

- Create and maintain customer jobs in ClickUp.

- Assign job numbers and upload accepted proposals.

- Upload customer photos, electricity bills and supporting documentation.

- Record salesperson, payment method and installation requirements.

- Follow up missing customer information.

- Keep job statuses accurate and up to date.



### 3. Payment Route Coordination – Brighte / Bank Transfer

- Confirm whether customers are paying through Brighte finance or bank transfer.

- Prepare and follow up Brighte finance applications.

- Request deposit invoices from the Finance Officer for bank-transfer customers.

- Confirm with finance that required deposits have been received.

- Progress jobs only once the applicable payment requirements have been satisfied.



**Note:** The Compliance Officer does not issue invoices, reconcile payments or manage customer accounts.



### 4. Permission to Connect (PTC)

- Prepare and submit PTC applications using approved system designs and technical information.

- Track application statuses and approvals.

- Follow up outstanding applications.

- Refer technical restrictions or required design changes to management.

- Ensure required connection approvals are obtained before installation.



### 5. Form Panda – Job Documentation

- Create installation jobs in Form Panda.

- Prepare installation forms and documentation.

- Obtain required customer and installer signatures.

- Verify that customer details, equipment and installation scope match OpenSolar and ClickUp.



### 6. Installation Preparation & Scheduling

- Prepare installation job sheets and installer documentation packs.

- Coordinate installation dates with customers and installers.

- Confirm equipment and stock availability with onsite warehouse staff.

- Ensure required customer photos, approvals and installation details are available.

- Confirm the job is ready for installation.

- Obtain management's technical release before dispatch.



### 7. Post-Installation Compliance Review

- Collect installation photos, equipment serial numbers and commissioning records.

- Check CCEWs, compliance forms, customer declarations and installer documentation.

- Review submitted documents against company compliance checklists.

- Identify missing or incorrect documentation.

- Follow up installers for outstanding evidence.

- Track rectification requests until resolved.

- Escalate technical compliance concerns to management for approval.



### 8. STC Documentation & Submission

- Prepare complete STC documentation packs.

- Submit completed job files to the company's authorised STC retailer or aggregator.

- Track submission acceptance and documentation requests.

- Follow up outstanding documents and resolve administrative queries.

- Provide submission references and expected proceeds to the Finance Officer.



This role involves preparing and submitting job documentation, not managing STC trading, aggregator accounts or financial reconciliation.



### 9. Brighte Completion & Settlement Documentation

- Prepare and submit required Brighte completion paperwork.

- Check customer declarations and signatures.

- Track settlement processing and follow up outstanding documentation.

- Provide settlement references and expected amounts to finance.



The Finance Officer is responsible for verifying actual payments received.



### 10. Customer Handover

- Prepare and send completed customer handover packs.

- Include CCEWs, equipment warranties, manuals and applicable compliance documents.

- Record when documents have been sent.

- Track customer app setup and handover completion.

- Escalate unresolved customer handover issues.



### 11. Job Completion & Installer Payment Readiness

- Update ClickUp when installation and compliance paperwork are complete.

- Confirm all required records are filed.

- Identify outstanding rectifications or incomplete items.

- Obtain technical completion approval from management.

- Notify the Finance Officer when installer invoices are ready for review.



The Compliance Officer does not approve or process installer payments.



## Systems & Software



Experience with the following platforms is highly desirable:



- **OpenSolar** – proposals and accepted system designs

- **ClickUp** – job tracking and workflow management

- **Form Panda** – installation and compliance documentation

- **Brighte** – finance applications and completion paperwork

- **Australian DNSP portals** – PTC applications

- **STC submission portals** – compliance documentation



Training will be provided on our internal procedures.



## Required Experience & Skills



- Previous experience in Australian solar or battery installation administration is strongly preferred.

- Experience coordinating installers and installation bookings.

- Understanding of Australian solar and battery compliance documentation.

- Familiarity with CCEWs, PTC applications and STC submission requirements.

- Strong attention to detail and document management skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT WANTED
description:
Social Media | Marketing | Website | Online Education | Business Support



Be Browed by Brooke is looking for a proactive, creative and organised Virtual Assistant to join the team!



I’m looking for a reliable and motivated VA to help support the growth of my beauty business, personal brand and online education projects.



I’m a beauty business owner specialising in cosmetic tattooing, brows, lips, beauty services and fine line tattooing. I’m also working towards expanding into online education and creating educational courses for other beauty professionals.



As the business grows, I’m looking for someone who can help bring my ideas to life, take tasks off my plate and support the behind-the-scenes operations of my business.



This role is perfect for someone who loves all things social media, marketing, content creation and business organisation, and who enjoys being part of a growing brand.



I don’t necessarily need someone who just waits for instructions. I want someone who can take initiative, bring ideas to the table, think creatively and help me turn my vision into reality.



THE ROLE



This will be a varied role involving social media management, marketing, website maintenance,
 marketing, online course development and general business administration.



I have plenty of ideas and projects I want to bring to life, and I’m looking for someone who can help me execute them efficiently and professionally.



1. Social Media & Content Creation



Helping me maintain a consistent, engaging and professional online presence across social media.



Responsibilities may include:

- Planning and organising social media content and content calendars.

- Creating Instagram posts, carousels, reels and stories.

- Helping brainstorm creative content ideas, hooks, captions and calls to action.

- Writing engaging captions that align with my brand voice.

- Turning my ideas, videos, photos and voice notes into ready-to-publish content.

- Repurposing existing content into different formats for Instagram,
 and other relevant platforms.

- Creating educational content around cosmetic tattooing, brows, lips, beauty treatments and the beauty industry.

- Designing graphics and carousels using Canva.

- Scheduling posts and organising content in advance.

- Keeping content consistent with my brand aesthetic and messaging.

- Researching relevant trends, content ideas and opportunities to increase engagement.

- Helping develop content that builds trust, attracts the right audience and encourages bookings.

- Assisting with promotional campaigns, service launches, special offers and business announcements.



The goal:  To help me show up consistently online without having to create every single piece of content myself.



2. Website Updates & Maintenance



Helping keep my website current, professional and aligned with the direction of my business.



Responsibilities may include:

- Updating website wording, images and service information.

- Adding or editing service descriptions and pricing when required.

- Updating website pages, links and calls to action.

- Uploading blog posts, educational resources or other content.

- Helping create landing pages for new offers, services, webinars and courses.

- Assisting with online course pages and student information.

- Checking that links, buttons and forms work correctly.

- Helping improve the overall customer journey from discovering my business to booking or purchasing.

- Assisting with website updates as new products, services or educational offerings are introduced.



Experience with website platforms and landing page builders is highly regarded. Please specify which platforms you have worked with.



3.
 Marketing



Helping me build and maintain an effective
 marketing strategy.



Responsibilities may include:

- Creating and formatting professional marketing
s.

- Writing engaging
 copy that sounds like my brand.

- Building and maintaining
 lists and subscriber segments.

- Setting up
 campaigns for promotions, launches and announcements.

- Creating
 sequences for new subscribers, enquiries and potential customers.

- Helping develop
 nurture sequences for future students and online course launches.

- Formatting newsletters and educational
s.

- Setting up automated
s where appropriate.

- Proofreading
s, checking links and testing
s before they are sent.

- Helping plan
 marketing calendars around upcoming launches, promotions and business goals.

- Reviewing
 campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.



I want
 marketing to become a more consistent part of my business, rather than something I only focus on when I have a launch or promotion coming up.



 4. Online Course Development & Education



This is an important part of the role as I work towards growing the education side of my business.



I’m looking for someone who can help me take my knowledge, ideas and experience and turn them into organised, easy-to-follow educational resources and course modules.



Responsibilities may include:

- Helping outline course structures and module topics.

- Turning my voice notes, rough notes and ideas into structured written content.

- Helping write and organise course modules, lessons and learning materials.

- Breaking complex topics into clear, logical and easy-to-understand lessons.

- Creating lesson summaries, worksheets, checklists and downloadable resources.

- Helping write student workbooks, guides and educational PDFs.

- Organising course content into lessons, sections and modules.

- Assisting with presentation slides and Canva resources.

- Helping develop course descriptions, sales pages and launch content.

- Writing student welcome
s and course communication.

- Assisting with course platform uploads and organisation.

- Helping create frequently asked questions and supporting resources for students.

- Proofreading course materials to ensure they are clear, consistent and professional.

- Helping repurpose course material into social media content and
 marketing.



You do not need to be a cosmetic tattooist or beauty educator, but you must be comfortable taking information I provide and helping turn it into polished, well-structured educational content. Any technical beauty content will be based on my expertise and reviewed by me.



5. General Business Administration & Organisation



Providing practical support with the everyday tasks that keep a business running smoothly.



Responsibilities may include:

- Managing and organising business documents and digital files.

- Keeping projects, deadlines and task lists organised.

- Assisting with planning launches, promotions and upcoming projects.

- Researching tools, platforms, suppliers and business opportunities.

- Creating templates, checklists, spreadsheets and standard operating procedures.

- Helping organise ideas and projects so they move from planning to execution.

- Drafting professional
s, messages and business communications.

- Assisting with client-facing resources and frequently asked questions.

- Helping organise testimonials, reviews and other business assets.

- Supporting the development of new services, digital products and educational offerings.

- Helping streamline repetitive tasks and improve business processes.

- Providing general administrative support as needed.



I want someone who enjoys creating order, finding solutions and making business operations more efficient.



6. Marketing, Launches & Business Growth



As I continue to grow my brand, I need support with the planning and execution of marketing activities.



This may include:

- Helping plan marketing campaigns and launch timelines.

- Assisting with promotions for beauty services and new offerings.

- Supporting webinar, workshop and online course launches.

- Writing promotional copy for social media,
s and website pages.

- Helping create lead magnets and free educational resources.

- Assisting with sales funnels and customer journeys.

- Researching content and marketing opportunities.

- Helping organise launch assets and promotional materials.

- Repurposing content across multiple platforms.

- Tracking basic marketing metrics and reporting on what is working.

- Bringing fresh ideas to the table to help grow brand awareness, bookings and future education sales.



I’m looking for someone who understands that content should have a purpose, whether that is building trust, educating an audience, generating enquiries or encouraging sales.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



The ideal person will be:



- **Proactive:** You take initiative and don't need every small task explained to you.

- **Organised:** You can manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities.

- **Creative:** You enjoy brainstorming ideas and creating engaging content.

- **A strong communicator:** You can write clearly, professionally and in a way that feels natural and engaging.

- **Detail-oriented:** You notice the little things, proofread your work and care about quality.

- **Resourceful:** You're comfortable researching solutions and learning new platforms.

- **Reliable:** You communicate well, meet deadlines and follow through on commitments.

- **Adaptable:** You're happy to work across different areas of the business as priorities change.

- **Growth-minded:** You enjoy being part of a growing business and helping bring new ideas to life.

- **Comfortable working independently:** You can take a brief, ask the right questions and deliver work with minimal supervision.



I value someone who is happy to share ideas, make suggestions and let me know when they see an opportunity to improve something.



## SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Experience in the following areas would be highly regarded:



- Social media management and content creation.

- Canva and graphic design.

- Instagram and
 content scheduling.

- Copywriting and content writing.

- Website editing and maintenance.

-
 marketing platforms and automations.

- Online course creation and educational content development.

- Landing pages and sales funnels.

- Digital product creation.

- Project management and administrative support.

- AI tools to assist with content creation, research and workflows.

- Marketing campaign planning and execution.



You don't have to be an expert in every area. I'm more interested in finding someone with strong foundational skills, a willingness to learn and the ability to take ownership of their work.



Please include the platforms and software you are experienced with in your application.



## THE TYPE OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE



I'm looking for someone who wants to become a genuine support system within my business.



Someone who can take a collection of ideas, notes and half-finished projects and help turn them into something tangible.



Someone who can help me stay consistent, organised and focused on the bigger picture while taking care of the tasks that often get pushed to the bottom of the list.



I want to build a good working relationship with someone I can trust, communicate openly with and potentially grow alongside as the business expands.



## POSITION DETAILS



- **Position:** Virtual Assistant

- **Business:** Be Browed by Brooke

- **Location:** Remote

- **Employment type:** To be discussed — freelance or ongoing part-time support.

- **Hours:** To be agreed based on experience, availability and business needs.

- **Rate:** Please include your hourly rate or package pricing in your application.

- **Start date:** Flexible for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you!



Please send through an introduction about yourself, your experience and why you think you'd be a good fit for this role.



Please include:



1. Your previous experience as a VA or in a similar role.

2. Examples or a portfolio of social media content, graphics,
s, websites or course materials you've created.

3. The platforms and software you are comfortable using.

4. Your experience with online course development and
 marketing.

5. Your availability, time zone and preferred working hours.

6. Your hourly rate or package pricing.

7. One or two examples of how you've helped another business save time, improve its marketing or bring a project to life.



I'm excited to find someone who can help me take the next steps in growing my business and bring some of the many ideas I have to life.



If you're creative, organised, proactive and love helping businesses grow, I'd love to hear from you!

title: Finance & Accounts Officer – Australian Business / Xero
description:
# Finance & Accounts Officer – Australian Business / Xero Experience



**Company:** AusGreen Energy Group Pty Ltd  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment:** Part-Time – 24 hours per week  

**Salary:** AUD $8–15 per hour (negotiable based on experience)



## About Us



AusGreen Energy Group is an Australian renewable energy company based in Sydney, NSW, specialising in residential and commercial solar PV systems, battery energy storage systems and electrical installations.



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and detail-oriented **Finance & Accounts Officer** to manage our day-to-day financial administration, bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, payroll preparation, financial reporting and job profitability tracking.



The successful candidate will work closely with our Compliance & Operations Officer, company directors and external accountants to maintain accurate financial records, improve financial visibility and ensure our business operates efficiently.



**Previous experience working with Australian businesses and using Xero is strongly preferred. Experience in the Australian solar, electrical or construction industry is a significant advantage.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Customer Invoicing

- Receive accepted proposals, job numbers and payment terms from the Compliance & Operations Officer.

- Prepare and issue customer deposit, progress and final invoices at agreed milestones.

- Check correct company entity, customer details, job references and approved pricing.

- Apply the appropriate GST treatment and payment terms.

- Record approved variations and prevent duplicate invoices.

- Maintain accurate customer invoicing records in Xero.



### 2. Accounts Receivable & Customer Payments

- Monitor customer payments and outstanding balances.

- Match customer receipts to the correct invoices.

- Allocate deposits, progress payments and final payments correctly.

- Follow up overdue customer accounts.

- Provide payment status updates to the Compliance Officer for ClickUp.

- Escalate disputed invoices, refunds and payment arrangements to management.



### 3. Brighte Finance Payment Tracking

- Track approved customer finance amounts and any customer contributions.

- Record completion submission dates and expected settlement amounts.

- Monitor outstanding and completed Brighte settlements.

- Reconcile actual receipts against expected amounts.

- Follow up documentation issues with the Compliance Officer.

- Report delayed, missing or incorrect settlements.



### 4. STC Payment Tracking

- Receive STC submission references and expected payment information from the Compliance Officer.

- Track expected STC proceeds for completed installations.

- Reconcile STC receipts against settlement statements.

- Maintain accurate records of paid and outstanding claims.

- Follow up overdue or incorrect payments.

- Escalate discrepancies to management.



### 5. Supplier Bills & Accounts Payable

- Enter supplier invoices and bills into Xero.

- Attach invoices and supporting documentation.

- Allocate equipment purchases, installation materials and other costs to the appropriate accounts and jobs.

- Verify invoice amounts against agreed supplier pricing.

- Record supplier credit notes and adjustments.

- Monitor payment due dates.

- Reconcile supplier statements and identify duplicate or incorrect charges.

- Confirm quantities received with onsite staff where required.



### 6. Supplier Credit Account Management

- Maintain a register of supplier credit limits.

- Monitor balances owing and available credit.

- Track open purchase orders and committed purchases.

- Calculate remaining purchasing capacity.

- Identify overdue supplier balances.

- Follow up missing credits and invoice discrepancies.

- Notify management when credit limits are approaching or exceeded.



### 7. Installer Invoices & Payment Preparation

- Receive installation completion confirmation from the Compliance Officer.

- Review installer invoices against agreed installation rates.

- Verify approved additional works and variations.

- Check completion approval and outstanding rectifications.

- Confirm payment terms and due dates.

- Prepare installer invoices for scheduled payment.

- Submit payment schedules to management for approval.



**The Finance Officer prepares payments but does not independently approve or release bank payments.**



### 8. Payroll Administration

- Prepare payroll using approved employee timesheets.

- Verify working hours, pay rates, leave and deductions.

- Maintain employee payroll and leave records.

- Prepare payroll summaries for management approval.

- Assist with Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting and superannuation administration within authorised responsibilities.

- Track payroll liabilities and payment deadlines.

- Refer payroll compliance questions to the external accountant.



### 9. Bookkeeping & Bank Reconciliation

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date Xero accounts.

- Reconcile bank accounts and payment transactions.

- Investigate unmatched or incorrectly allocated transactions.

- Review transaction descriptions, account codes and GST treatment.

- Collect missing receipts, invoices and supporting documents.

- Identify duplicate payments or transactions.

- Maintain accurate customer and supplier balances.

- Refer uncertain accounting or tax matters to our external accountant.



### 10. Fixed Costs & Subscription Management

- Maintain a register of recurring business expenses.

- Track rent, insurance, software subscriptions, vehicle expenses, finance repayments and other fixed costs.

- Monitor renewal dates, notice periods and upcoming payments.

- Identify unnecessary subscriptions and duplicate charges.

- Report cost increases and potential savings.

- Prepare recommendations for management review.



### 11. Scheduled Payments & Cash Commitments

- Prepare payment schedules for supplier invoices, installer invoices, payroll and recurring expenses.

- Confirm amounts, supporting documents and due dates.

- Identify urgent payments and overdue liabilities.

- Prepare projected cash requirements.

- Submit payment batches for director approval.

- Track approved and completed payments.



**Bank payment authorisation and release remain the responsibility of company directors or other specifically authorised personnel.**



### 12. Inventory, Stock Costs & Job Profitability

- Maintain accurate equipment purchase costs in Xero.

- Assist with inventory and stock cost tracking.

- Reconcile supplier purchases against confirmed warehouse stock records.

- Track equipment costs, installer charges, labour and other direct job expenses.

- Allocate costs to the correct installation jobs.

- Calculate revenue, direct costs and gross profit for completed jobs.

- Identify missing costs, incorrect allocations and unexplained stock discrepancies.

- Prepare job profitability summaries for management.



Physical stock counts will be performed or confirmed by onsite warehouse personnel.



## Financial Reporting Responsibilities



The Finance Officer will be responsible for preparing regular financial reports to assist management with business decisions.



### Fortnightly Finance Report



Prepare a report covering:



**1. Cash Position**

- Current bank balances and available funds.

- Upcoming payroll, tax and other commitments.

- Expected cash requirements.



**2. Money Coming In**

- Outstanding customer invoices.

- Overdue customer payments.

- Expected Brighte settlements.

- Outstanding STC proceeds.

- Expected payment dates.



**3. Money Going Out**

- Supplier bills due.

- Installer payments due.

- Payroll obligations.

- Rent, insurance and recurring expenses.



**4. Supplier Credit**

- Supplier credit limits.

- Current outstanding balances.

- Open purchase orders.

- Remaining available credit.



**5. Cash Flow Forecast**

- Expected incoming and outgoing funds.

- Projected cash position for the next 8–12 weeks.

- Potential cash shortages or upcoming financial risks.



**6. Issues Requiring Management Attention**

- Overdue customer accounts.

- Supplier payment disputes.

- Missing credits.

- Unreconciled transactions.

- Financial approvals required.



### Monthly Finance Report



Prepare a comprehensive monthly financial report including:



- Profit and Loss Statement – monthly and year-to-date.

- Balance Sheet.

- Revenue by solar, battery and electrical installation categories.

- Completed job profitability and gross margins.

- Operating expenses and overheads.

- Budget versus actual expenditure, where budgets are available.

- Customer accounts receivable ageing.

- Supplier accounts payable ageing.

- Supplier credit utilisation.

- Stock valuation and inventory discrepancies.

- Payroll, superannuation and tax liabilities.

- Fixed cost and subscription changes.

- Outstanding accounting issues requiring accountant review.



Clearly identify any figures that are incomplete, estimated or awaiting reconciliation.



## Daily, Weekly & Monthly Working Routine



### Daily

- Check customer receipts.

- Issue invoices when payment milestones are reached.

- Enter and review supplier bills.

- Update outstanding customer and supplier balances.

- Monitor urgent Brighte and STC settlements.

- Escalate urgent financial issues.



### Weekly

- Complete bank and account reconciliations.

- Follow up overdue customer payments.

- Update supplier credit registers.

- Review outstanding Brighte and STC payments.

- Prepare upcoming payment schedules.

- Review recurring expenses and commitments.

- Coordinate outstanding matters with the Compliance Officer.



### Each Payroll Cycle

- Review approved timesheets.

- Prepare payroll.

- Submit payroll summary for director approval.

- Complete authorised payroll reporting and record keeping.



### Fortnightly

- Submit the cash flow and financial commitments report.

- Identify outstanding debts, upcoming expenses and management decisions required.



### Monthly

- Complete month-end reconciliations.

- Prepare financial statements and management reports.

- Review job profitability and stock costs.

- Identify unresolved accounting discrepancies.

- Coordinate outstanding accounting matters with our external accountants.



## Systems & Software



**Essential:**

- Xero – bookkeeping, invoicing, bills, reconciliation and reporting.

- Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets – financial tracking and reporting.

- Strong understanding of Australian GST and bookkeeping practices.



**Highly Desirable:**

- ClickUp – job tracking and communication.

- Brighte – finance settlement tracking.

- Experience with inventory and job costing systems.

- Australian payroll, STP and superannuation administration.

- Experience working with Australian accountants.



## Required Experience & Skills



- Previous experience as a Finance Officer, Bookkeeper or Accounts Officer.

- Strong practical experience using Xero.

- Experience with Australian business accounting and GST.

- Knowledge of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Experience performing bank reconciliations.

- Ability to prepare financial reports and cash flow forecasts.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

- High level of confidentiality and professionalism.

- Ability to identify financial discrepancies and proactively resolve issues.



### Preferred Industry Experience



Candidates with previous experience in the following industries will receive priority consideration:



1. Australian solar and battery installation companies.

2. Australian electrical contracting businesses.

3. Australian construction and trade services.

4. Businesses using Xero for inventory, job costing and financial reporting.



## Working Arrangements



- Remote position based in the Philippines.

- Initially 24 hours per week, across three working days.

- Working hours aligned with Sydney, Australia.

- Opportunity to increase hours based on performance and business requirements.

- Long-term employment opportunity for the right candidate.



## First Priorities After Joining



The successful candidate will initially focus on:



1. Reviewing our existing Xero setup and identifying outstanding bookkeeping issues.

2. Bringing bank reconciliations and financial records up to date.

3. Verifying opening customer and supplier balances.

4. Establishing accurate customer receivables and supplier payables tracking.

5. Creating supplier credit limit and outstanding balance registers.

6. Establishing a fixed cost and subscription register.

7. Setting up fortnightly financial reporting.

8. Establishing monthly Profit and Loss, cash flow and job profitability reporting.

9. Working with the Compliance Officer to establish clear financial handover procedures.

10. Identifying discrepancies requiring review by management or our external accountants.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



### Xero & Accounting Experience



1. How many years of experience do you have working as a Finance Officer or Bookkeeper?

2. How many years have you worked with Australian businesses?

3. How would you rate your Xero experience, and which Xero functions have you used?

4. Have you managed accounts payable, accounts receivable and bank reconciliations in Xero?

5. Do you have experience with Australian GST, BAS preparation, payroll, STP and superannuation?

6. Have you prepared monthly Profit and Loss statements, balance sheets and cash flow reports?



### Industry & Financial Management



7. Have you previously worked for an Australian solar, electrical or construction company?

8. Have you managed supplier credit accounts and outstanding balances?

9. Have you tracked inventory costs and calculated profitability for individual jobs?

10. Have you prepared supplier payment batches for management approval?

11. Have you tracked customer finance settlements or other third-party payments?



### Practical Experience



12. Explain how you would identify and resolve a bank transaction that does not match an invoice in Xero.

13. How would you track money owed by customers, supplier bills due and expected cash flow for the next eight weeks?

14. What financial reports would you provide to directors to help them understand business profitability and cash flow?



### Availability & Salary



15. What is your expected hourly rate in AUD?

16. Are you available to work 24 hours per week during Sydney business hours?

17. When would you be available to start?



## Important Application Instructions



Please begin your application with the words **"XERO FINANCE"** to confirm you have read the full job description.



Applications that do not answer the screening questions may not be considered.



We are looking for a reliable, experienced and proactive Finance Officer who can take ownership of our financial administration, maintain accurate records and provide meaningful financial information to support the continued growth of AusGreen Energy Group.



**We look forward to hearing from you!**

description:

This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Get certified in 30–60 days through consistent quality work and leadership approval.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 9 PM – 11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process - it must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.

BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent, professional English

- Clear spoken communication

- Emotional intelligence

- Be calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



You’ll THRIVE here if you:



- Enjoy speaking on camera with clients

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without being micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients

title: High-Ticket Sales Closer — Inbound
description:
We're hiring experienced high-ticket closers for inbound calls only.



$2,100 AUD per enrolment. Uncapped.

KPI: 8 commitment fees a month. You're paid $2,100 per enrolment that follows, and we usually find those who pay the commitment fee almost always commence for enrolment.

OTE: $201,600 AUD a year for a closer hitting target.

60-day ramp: an additional $1,500 AUD/month while you learn the product, non-recoverable, on top of your commission.



ABOUT LICENCEPATH



We help experienced tradies and workers — carpenters, electricians, bricklayers and more — get their trade certificate and licence so they can take the next step in their career.



This is a regulated industry and a legal requirement for every tradie to have. Plenty of good tradesmen have the skills and the years on the tools but not the piece of paper the government requires to work for themselves, charge properly, or run their own jobs. We close that gap — through short-course gap-training and recognition of the experience they already have — and get them licensed much faster than the traditional way. We're talking years to weeks.



For the tradesman, a licence changes everything: their own contracts, uncapped income, the freedom to run their own show. For you, it's a sales role you can actually stand behind. You're not talking anyone into anything they don't need — you're helping someone unlock the career they've already earned. That's rare in sales, and it makes the job easier and the money better.



We have our own blue ocean, focusing on specific licences that are very difficult for anyone else to offer. There's barely any competition. So it's not hard to show people the value in this.



THE ROLE



Every lead has already filled out an eligibility form to check whether they can get their trade licence through gap-training or experience. So they've put their hand up before you ever speak to them. No cold calling. No prospecting. No chasing dead leads.



Your job: get on the phone, explain the process, handle the objections, and move them down the line toward getting licensed.



These are government-regulated licences — a legal requirement to work in their trade. The customer needs this. We just make it faster and simpler than doing it alone. That makes the sale close to a no-brainer, and your job is to push it over the line.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Take inbound calls from people who've already checked their eligibility

Explain the pathway clearly, in plain language

Handle the objections that come up — price, time, requirements

Guide them through commitment and enrolment

Keep 
ntum: every lead called fast, every deal followed through



WHAT YOU EARN



$2,100 AUD per enrolment, paid upfront. Uncapped.

KPI: 8 commitment fees paid a month.

OTE: $201,600 AUD+ a year.



WHO WE WANT



You've closed high-ticket over the phone before — real deals, real objections, real money.

You hold a price. You don't fold the 
nt someone pushes for a discount.

You can talk to a tradesman. Our customers are blunt and sceptical.

Clear, confident English on the phone.

You know how to work a sales cycle.

You understand the importance of speed to lead.

You're a hunter — not someone looking for a clock-on, clock-off job. You understand that when a lead comes in, that's a $2,100 phone call waiting, and you're not going to let it sit until it burns.



BEFORE YOU APPLY — TIMEZONE



We're based in New South Wales, Australia (AEST/AEDT), and our leads cluster around two windows: 7–10am and 1–4pm Sydney time. Those are the hours the phone runs hot and the ones that matter most for speed to lead.



Wherever you are in the world, apply — but be honest with yourself about whether you can be live and hunting during those Sydney windows. Work out what they land at in your timezone before you send your note. If those hours don't work for your life, this seat won't either.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us a Loom or voice note — your choice — answering these questions:



Where have you worked?

What have you sold before?

What was your biggest commission month, and what were you selling?

Tell us the story of your biggest close.

Why did you leave your last role?

What are you looking for in a career job?



Keep it loose — two to five minutes. We want to hear how you actually sound, so record it yourself rather than reading a script.



Include the link to your recording in your application message.



WAGE/SALARY

$2,100 AUD per enrolment + $1,500 AUD/month ramp (60 days)

title: Video Editor & AI Creative Strategist — Meta Ads (Ecommerce / Digital Products)
description:
Are YOU an experienced video editor who specializes in Meta Ads for ecommerce brands? Can you look at a competitor's winning ad and immediately understand why it works — the hook, the pacing, the clip choice, the emotional beat — and replicate that thinking, not just the edit?

If you answered an enthusiastic "YES," KEEP READING.

We run an international ecommerce brand selling both physical and digital products (ebooks, video courses) to English-speaking audiences in the US, UK, EU, and Australia. We're looking for a dedicated, full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and eventually grow into Head of Video Editing.

We're not chasing virality. Our goal is one thing: ads that stop the scroll and sell. Every video needs a hook strong enough to interrupt scrolling, and an edit that keeps attention high all the way through.

What you'll own:

Sales-Focused Ad Production: Editing high-conversion Meta ads from scripts we provide — built to sell, not to go viral.

AI Scene Generation & Recreation: Hands-on fluency with AI video tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, and similar) to generate or recreate scenes and B-roll when what we have isn't enough — you don't wait for footage, you create it.

Clip Curation & Sourcing: We'll provide a folder of selected B-rolls; if additional clips are needed, you source or generate them autonomously. High-quality only — traditional stock footage (Shutterstock, Envato, etc.) is strictly FORBIDDEN.

Script-to-Screen Interpretation: We give you the hook and body copy; you d
 pacing, cuts, and visual rhythm to maximize watch-through and conversion.

Strategic Input, Not Just Execution: We want a creative partner, not a pair of hands. You should actively propose new hooks, new formats, and new angles based on what you're seeing perform — not wait to be told what to test next.

Constant Trend Awareness: You're the kind of editor who's already testing a new AI tool or ad format before we ask about it. Staying ahead of trends in short-form ad creative is part of the job, not an extra.

Subtitle & Detail Precision: Clean, perfectly synced subtitles, no typos, no timing errors — this is an area where we accept zero compromise.

Reliable, On-Time Delivery: Every deadline is a real deadline. Late deliveries disrupt the whole ad pipeline, and consistency here matters as much as editing skill.

Position Requirements:

Full-time availability. This is not a 2-hours-a-day gig. If you're currently juggling 5–6 different clients and can't guarantee us priority and focus, please don't apply.

Immediate or near-immediate start.

2+ years of specific experience editing Meta Ads for ecommerce brands — physical product experience is fine, but experience with digital products (ebooks, courses, info-products) is a strong plus.

Practical experience with AI video generation tools (Google Flow, Higgsfield, or equivalents) — this is not optional, it's core to how we produce content now.

Fluent English — our team and all creative content are in English; you need to understand tone, nuance, and pacing at a native or near-native level.

Strong grasp of hook, retention, and pacing — you should be able to explain why a cut works, not just execute it.

A strategic, growth-minded approach — you think about what's next for the brand's creative, not just what's on today's task list.

Weekend availability when needed, paid accordingly.

Obsessive attention to detail. Subtitles, transitions, and timing must be clean. Mediocrity isn't tolerated on this team.

Genuine passion for the craft of editing, and for staying current with where it's heading.

What We Offer:

Performance bonuses tied to ad results, starting from month one.

Real growth path to Head of Video Editing as the brand scales.

Direct involvement in an international brand's creative strategy — your instincts and proposals shape what we test next.
