title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

Amazon Wholesale Product Researcher — Part Time



Pay: $3–7 USD/hour based on demonstrated skills, plus performance bonuses.

Hours: Initially 10 hours/week, with potential to increase.

Location: Remote, Philippines.



ABOUT JKB WHOLESALE



JKB Wholesale is a Texas-based business sourcing wholesale products for resale on Amazon in the United States. We’re looking for one experienced researcher to help evaluate supplier catalogs and build a reliable product-selection process.



We value accurate research, honest communication and a respectful working relationship. This position has potential to become an ongoing role as our business grows.



THE ROLE



Your initial focus will be analyzing supplier price lists and maintaining a clear research spreadsheet. You should already understand Amazon wholesale research. We will provide onboarding to our specific criteria, reporting format and approval process.



Main responsibilities:

• Match supplier products to Amazon listings, verifying UPC, size, variation, pack count and case quantities.

• Review Keepa price history, estimated demand, Buy Box competition and Amazon presence.

• Calculate FBA and FBM profitability, including relevant product, shipping, prep and Amazon costs.

• Flag supplier minimums, restrictions, expiration concerns and questions requiring verification.

• Record supporting links, calculations and clear recommendations in our research Sheet.



Accurate rejection of unsuitable products is valuable. We do not expect a guaranteed number of profitable leads.



TECHNICAL SKILLS — REQUIRED



• Relevant U.S. Amazon wholesale product-research experience.

• Strong Keepa analysis and accurate product matching.

• Understanding of FBA/FBM economics and case-to-sellable-unit calculations.

• Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filtering and lookups.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



• Seller Assistant, SellerAmp or similar tools.

• Bulk catalog screening and data cleanup.

• Understanding of MAP policies, brand restrictions and Amazon eligibility checks.



COMMUNICATION AND WORK HABITS



• Clear written English and attention to detail.

• Reliable progress updates and agreed deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions, flag uncertainty and report mistakes promptly.

• Ability to work independently and explain your reasoning.

• Reliable computer and internet connection.



We welcome questions and process improvements. Research tools, access and communication times will be agreed before starting.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND EXCLUSIVITY



Our confidential supplier relationships, pricing, catalogs, curated leads and research must not be shared, sold, published or used for yourself or other clients. No subcontracting or sharing access.



Written confidentiality terms are required before private materials are provided.



The ongoing role requires exclusive commitment: no other clients, lead-selling activities or competing personal Amazon sourcing during the engagement. Compensation, guaranteed hours and the exclusive start date must be mutually agreed before this requirement begins.



All purchases and supplier commitments require owner approval.



PAY AND SELECTION



• $3–6 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated ability.

• A paid 3–5-hour assessment, with rate and payment terms agreed in advance. Assessment payment does not depend on being hired.

• Weekly payment initially.

• Performance bonuses based on criteria agreed in writing.

• Potential for increased hours, responsibilities and compensation as performance and business needs justify.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with “WHOLESALE ANALYST” and include:



1. A brief summary of your relevant experience and research tools.

2. Your requested hourly rate and weekly availability.

3. Current client commitments, any personal Amazon business or lead-selling activities, and the rate/hours you would require for exclusivity.

4. One redacted work sample you have permission to share.

5. A short explanation of how you detect pack-count mismatches and evaluate an unstable Keepa chart.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and paid assessment. Relevant references may be requested.

title: Short-Form Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
About Us

We are a small Australian performance marketing consultancy. We run Google and Meta ads for businesses in Australia, Europe and the US. Our founder worked at Google and Meta before starting the company. We all work remotely.



About The Role

We are looking for a short-form video editor who also designs clean static graphics, and who knows how each platform works. Someone with a sharp eye for detail.

We film the raw footage and write a short brief. You turn it into finished videos and graphics in the style we already use, for three kinds of work:

* Our own channels: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, 
 and
.

* Ads for our own products, starting with our two playbooks.

* From month three, the same work for our clients, in each client’s brand.

* We d
 what to make, why, and for whom. You own how it looks, how it lands on each platform, and that every detail is right.

* This is project-based work, paid per finished piece from one rate card that covers all three. No hourly rate and no hours to log. To start: roughly 4 to 5 videos, 2 carousels and 2 blog covers a week for our channels, sent as one weekly batch, plus a batch of ads whenever we refresh the playbook campaigns.



What You Would Do

* Edit talking-head and B-roll footage into 15 to 60 second vertical videos (9:16, 1080 x 1920).

* Design static posts, carousels and ad graphics from our templates and brand guide (Canva or Figma), in every size we need.

* Cut ads from our footage: 15 to 30 seconds, several hooks on the same body, in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1. Every figure in an ad must match the source exactly, never rounded.

* Follow our house style exactly: one brand typeface, clean captions, numbers on screen, no emoji or stickers.

* Pick the best takes, cut the pauses, and keep the pacing tight without making it feel rushed.

* Check every number, name and word against the script or brief.

* Blur anything confidential that appears on a screen or in notes.

* Brand check everything before it goes out: typeface, capitals on terms like ROAS, safe zones, and no TikTok under 7 seconds.

* Deliver the weekly batch within 3 working days of receiving the footage and briefs, to our shared Drive folder, with the project files. Revisions within 24 hours.



Know The Platforms

The same video does not work the same way on five channels. We never post a TikTok under 7 seconds. Captions carry every video, because many people watch with the sound off. Nothing important sits where Instagram’s buttons cover it. We want someone who knows rules like these without being told, and spots new ones before we do.

* Keep a one-page platform sheet: length, hook timing, safe zones, text and caption style for each of the five channels. Keep it current.

* Apply it to every export.

* If a brief will not work on a platform, tell us before you edit, and suggest the fix.

* With each weekly batch: five trends or formats that fit our style, with links. Part of the per-piece rate, not extra.

That judgement is yours to use. What to make stays with us.



How We Work

* We are warm with each other and with our clients. People first, then the task.

* We read the person, not just the message.

* We want you to disagree with us, including with the founder, when you think we are wrong. Say it kindly and say it early.

* We check before we claim. If you are not sure something is right, say so.



One Firm Rule

No AI-generated images, AI voices or AI avatars, ever. Our brand is built on real footage and real design. Standard editing tools (auto-captions, noise removal, colour correction) are fine.



What You Get From Us

Raw footage, a short brief per piece (hook, key points, figures, call to action), our brand guide, templates and examples of finished work. Every piece has its own card in Trello/Google doc with the brief already filled in. You never start without one, and you never have to guess.



What We Are Looking For

* A portfolio of short-form talking-head or founder-led videos, and static social or ad designs.

* Clean, restrained work. Premium, not flashy.

* Obsessive attention to detail. A wrong figure or a typo is the kind of thing we notice, and so should you.

* Reliable turnaround and clear written English.



A bonus, not required: experience with ad creative for Meta or TikTok.



Room To Grow

We want someone for the long term, and the work grows with us.

* Month one: our own channels and our playbook ads.

* From month three, if quality and deadlines hold: client work, in each client’s brand, under our name. More pieces, same rate card.

After that: running our production board and quality checks.

Your rates are reviewed at each step. What you will not own is strategy: we or the client d
 what to make, and you make it excellent.



Hours

We work Melbourne time. Your day should overlap with ours for a few hours so we can turn feedback around quickly. No night shifts.



How We Hire

A short paid test, US$15: one 30-second video from our raw footage, exported for TikTok and for LinkedIn with two lines on what you changed and why, and one static post from our template. The strongest two or three then get a second paid test, US$40: one 20-second ad for our playbook with two different hooks, in 9:16 and 4:5, and a 3-slide carousel. We pay for all of it either way, and we will tell you how you did.

Your first month is a trial for both of us. Before you start, you sign a short contractor agreement covering confidentiality, that the work you make for us is ours, and that client work is done under our name, from a Dadek
 address.



How To Apply

Please start your message with the word “margin”, so we know you have read this.

Then answer four questions:



1. Send links to two or three short-form videos and two or three static designs you made, and tell us which tools you use. Founder or talking-head videos if you have them.

2. What is your rate in US dollars for each of these: one finished 30 to 60 second video from raw footage, one ad version cut from a finished video (new hook or new size), one 5-slide carousel, and one single static post?

3. We post the same video to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, 
 and
. Name two things you would change between them, and why.

4. Have you ever caught a mistake before it went out? What happened?



Keep it short. Good work and honest answers tell us more than a long application.

title: Appointment scheduler and lead  in the generation specialist
description:
Position Overview

EFC is hiring a results-driven Appointment Setter / Lead Generation Specialist to dial provided leads, prequalify pre-retirees, and book qualified appointments on the Senior Wealth Advisor's calendar. This starts as gig work, with a path to part-time or full-time employment based on results.





Title

Appointment Setter / Lead Generation Specialist

Company

EFC Wealth Management Firm, LLC

Location

Los Angeles, CA (5901 W Century Blvd) or remote

Engagement

Gig / contract, performance-based conversion to part-time or full-time

Reports to

Founder & Senior Wealth Advisor

About EFC Wealth Management

EFC Wealth Management Firm, LLC is a California Registered Investment Advisor in Los Angeles, serving clients since 2003. We specialize in retirement planning for pre-retirees with substantial assets, guided by our Code 2 Retirement™ framework. Our founder has nearly 30 years in financial services and is the author of The Retirement Game.

Key Responsibilities

• Make high-volume outbound calls to leads supplied by EFC's marketing sources (seminars, workshops, digital campaigns, referrals).

• Prequalify each lead against EFC criteria: age, retirement timeline, investable assets, and interest in planning.

• Book qualified appointments directly on the Senior Wealth Advisor's calendar and send confirmations.

• Confirm upcoming appointments and reschedule no-shows to protect advisor time.

• Log every call, outcome, and note accurately in EFC's CRM.

• Report daily and weekly activity: dials, contacts, appointments set, appointments kept.

• Follow all Do Not Call, TCPA, and firm compliance scripts; never give investment, tax, or insurance advice.

Target Client Profile

You will be speaking with pre-retirees and retirees, typically age 57 and older, who are planning for or approaching retirement. Success requires patience, respect, and the ability to build trust quickly with an older, financially cautious audience.

• Age 57+, within roughly 10 years of retirement or recently retired

• Holding 401(k), IRA, pension, or other retirement savings

• Concerned about retirement income, taxes, Social Security timing, or market risk

Required Qualifications

• Proven lead generation experience, including working purchased, event, and digital lead lists

• Proven track record in appointment setting and phone sales, with numbers you can share (dials per day, set rate, show rate)

• Fluent, professional spoken English; clear and easily understood on the phone

• Comfortable making 100+ outbound dials per day and handling objections with confidence

• Experience scheduling directly onto an advisor's or closer's calendar

• Working knowledge of CRM and dialer software

• Reliable phone, computer, and high-speed internet (if remote)

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in insurance, annuities, or financial services

• Experience setting appointments for financial advisors, especially for retirement or seminar-based practices

• Active California Life & Health insurance license, or willingness to obtain one

• Understanding of retirement topics: 401(k) rollovers, IRAs, Social Security, Medicare

Performance Expectations and Path to Employment

This role is earned on results: hit the targets during the gig period and you are offered a part-time or full-time position.

Stage

Length

What we measure

Gig / trial

First 30–60 days

Dials, contacts, qualified appointments set, show rate

Part-time offer

After consistent targets

Appointments kept per week, CRM accuracy, reliability

Full-time offer

Sustained results

Appointment-to-client conversion, consistency

Open question: weekly targets (e.g., qualified appointments set and kept) to be set by EFC before posting.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations & Systems Manager to own day-to-day execution across people, processes, systems, and technology.



In this role, you will be the first point of contact for work-related and system problems—ensuring issues are investigated, resolved, delegated, automated, or escalated appropriately before reaching Leadership. This is a multi-hat position for an operations-minded problem solver who knows how to connect the pieces between project management, CRMs, automations, and team execution to keep the entire system running smoothly.



What Success Looks Like

Problems are identified, investigated, and solved before reaching Leadership. You understand operational and technical blockers, determine the required actions, assign the right team members, and follow tasks through to resolution.



Key Responsibilities

* Operations Management: Keep projects, deliverables, and weekly priorities moving smoothly across Sales, Marketing,    Operations, and IT.

* Process Optimization: Identify bottlenecks, simplify workflows, refine SOPs, and eliminate unnecessary manual work.

* Systems Management: Oversee how CRM, payments, automations, communication tools, and internal systems connect and flow together.

* Technical Coordination: Translate business and operational problems into clear technical requirements and briefs for developers and automation specialists.

* Team Management: Run 1:1 meetings, track team performance, coach underperformance, and hold staff accountable to key deliverables.

* Problem Resolution: Act as the first line of defense to troubleshoot operational or technical issues before escalating to Leadership.

* SOP & Quality Control: Ensure established processes for payments, invoicing, commissions, sourcing, and onboarding are strictly followed.

* Hiring & Onboarding: Support final candidate interviews for specialist roles and manage end-to-end onboarding for new hires.



Technical & Core Requirements

*  CRM Operations: Daily working experience inside CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar)—managing contacts, pipelines, tags, custom fields, and smart lists, as well as troubleshooting data discrepancies.

* Automation Logic: Ability to read and understand workflows in GoHighLevel, Make, Zapier, or n8n (triggers, actions, filters, conditions) and identify where a flow broke using run history.

* Integration Fundamentals: Solid grasp of how platforms exchange data (webhooks, API connections, field mapping) and why records fail to sync (e.g.,
 mismatches across Shopify and CRM).

* Workflow Mapping: Proven ability to turn complex or messy processes into clear, step-by-step workflow maps to identify gaps, redundancies, and handoff failures.

* Technical Brief Writing: Ability to write clear requirement briefs for technical builders (trigger, expected outcome, test cases, owners) without requiring back-and-forth alignment calls.

* Project Management Tools: Hands-on experience building and managing task boards, deadlines, and team assignments in ClickUp or similar platforms.

* Spreadsheets & Documentation: Working knowledge of Google Sheets / Excel for tracking and data management, alongside strong SOP writing skills.

* AI Tool Integration: Daily use of ChatGPT or Claude for drafting SOPs, summarizing information, cleaning data, and troubleshooting (with strict quality checks on outputs).

* Remote Collaboration: Fully comfortable working via Slack, Google Workspace, Loom, and video calls.



Nice-to-Have Experience

* Experience as a CRM Administrator / GoHighLevel Virtual Assistant.

* Background in HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, or onboarding support.

* Experience as a Team Lead or Supervisor managing remote teams.

* Startup or agency operations background.

* Experience or interest in the sports, athletic development, or coaching industry.



Tools Used in This Role

title: Klaviyo Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Manager
description:
About 




 is an established e-commerce retailer specializing in printer ink, toner, and related supplies.



Unlike many e-commerce categories, our products are consumables with a natural replenishment cycle. A customer purchasing a cartridge today is likely to need another cartridge in the future. We believe this creates a significant opportunity to build a sophisticated lifecycle and retention marketing program around customer purchase history, printer compatibility, replenishment timing, and personalization.



We are looking for an experienced Klaviyo Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Manager to take ownership of this channel and grow it into a larger and more predictable revenue source.



This is not primarily an
-design position. We are looking for someone who thinks about customer behavior, segmentation, lifecycle, experimentation, retention, and ultimately revenue.



Current Program



The successful candidate will inherit an established Klaviyo program rather than starting from scratch.



Recent 90-day performance is approximately:



 represents approximately 16.4% of total revenue

Approximately 69% of Klaviyo revenue comes from flows

Approximately 31% comes from campaigns

Campaign RPR is approximately $0.047

Campaign open rates are strong, but click-through and conversion performance have significant room for improvement

Several existing flows—including Welcome, Browse Abandonment and Cart Abandonment—already generate meaningful revenue

Replenishment/Predictive Purchase, Reorder and Post-Purchase programs represent substantial opportunities for improvement



Our objective is not simply to send more
s. We want to increase the economic value of every customer relationship.



Primary Responsibilities



You will own the strategy, execution, measurement, and continuous improvement of our Klaviyo program.



Your responsibilities will include campaign strategy and execution, segmentation, automated flows, personalization, deliverability, testing, reporting, and revenue optimization.



A major priority will be rebuilding our replenishment strategy. We want to move beyond generic "time to reorder"
s toward intelligent lifecycle marketing using purchase history, SKU/product information, cartridge type, printer compatibility, previous order quantities, and observed repurchase behavior.



You will also be expected to improve our campaign program. Our open rates are already strong; the larger opportunity is improving click rate, conversion rate and revenue per recipient.



Lifecycle & Automation Ownership



You will audit, rebuild and continuously optimize programs including:



Welcome

Browse abandonment

Added-to-cart abandonment

Checkout abandonment

Post-purchase

Replenishment/reorder

Predictive purchase

Winback

Sunset/list hygiene

Back-in-stock

Cross-sell and upsell

Printer-model onboarding

High-value/VIP customers

Business/bulk buyers



We are particularly interested in someone capable of answering questions such as:



When should a customer who purchased a specific cartridge receive a reorder message?



Should someone who bought a 4-pack receive the same replenishment sequence as someone who bought a single cartridge?



How can purchase history and printer compatibility determine the products shown in an
?



How should lifecycle timing change as we learn an individual customer's actual reorder cadence?



Campaign Management



Develop and manage an ongoing campaign calendar, generally involving approximately 2–4 campaigns per week.



The emphasis should be on quality and revenue efficiency rather than simply increasing send volume.



Campaign strategy should include promotional campaigns, replenishment opportunities, brand/product campaigns, educational content, bundles, cross-sells, customer-specific recommendations and targeted offers.



The manager should actively experiment with audience, offer, merchandising, content, CTA, timing and creative—but testing should be tied to meaningful business hypotheses rather than testing for its own sake.



Segmentation & Personalization



We expect this person to substantially improve how we use customer data.



Potential segmentation includes:



Purchase history

Product/SKU purchased

Printer brand/model

Expected replenishment period

First-time vs. repeat customer

Purchase frequency

Customer lifetime value

Average order value

Engagement

Discount sensitivity

Business/bulk purchasing behavior

Lapsed customers



Experience building dynamic Klaviyo content and product recommendations is highly desirable.



Performance & KPIs



This position will be measured primarily on business outcomes, not
 volume or design output.



Primary KPIs will include:



Klaviyo-attributed revenue

Incremental
 revenue

 revenue as a percentage of total revenue

Revenue per recipient

Flow revenue

Campaign revenue

Repeat purchase rate

Customer purchase frequency

Conversion rate

Click rate



Guardrail metrics will include unsubscribe rate, spam complaint rate, bounce rate and overall deliverability.



Our initial goal is to materially increase
's contribution from its current ~16% of company revenue, while maintaining healthy list quality and avoiding artificial growth caused simply by sending more
s.



First 90 Days



We expect the successful candidate to quickly understand the existing program and prioritize the highest-value opportunities.



During the first 90 days, we would expect substantial progress toward:



First 30 days: Audit the account, establish KPI baselines, understand customer purchasing behavior, identify campaign and flow opportunities, and develop a prioritized roadmap.



Days 31–60: Begin rebuilding the replenishment/reorder strategy, improve campaign segmentation and monetization, address deliverability/list hygiene issues, and launch the highest-priority tests.



Days 61–90: Expand personalization, introduce new lifecycle flows where justified, measure incremental results and establish a repeatable testing and optimization process.



We care much more about measurable improvement than the number of projects completed.



Required Experience



Candidates should have strong hands-on experience with:



Klaviyo

Shopify e-commerce

Lifecycle/retention marketing

Automated flows

Advanced segmentation

E-commerce analytics

A/B testing

Deliverability and list health

Revenue attribution and reporting



Experience with consumables, replenishment businesses, subscriptions, auto parts, beauty, supplements, pet supplies, office supplies, or other repeat-purchase categories is especially valuable.



Basic HTML/email-template knowledge is helpful, but this role does not require the candidate to personally perform sophisticated graphic design or custom coding if those capabilities can be supported separately.



What We're Looking For



The ideal person should be able to look at an
 program and ask:



"Where is the next $10,000/month of incremental revenue going to come from?"



—not simply:



"What
s should we send next month?"



We want someone analytical enough to work with data, commercial enough to understand offers and merchandising, creative enough to develop compelling campaigns, and technical enough to take advantage of Klaviyo's automation and personalization capabilities.



Compensation



We are open to either a full-time employee or a highly committed dedicated contractor, depending on experience and location.



We are interested in a 70% fixed / 30% performance-based compensation structure, with the variable component tied primarily to measurable incremental performance.



Performance compensation may consider:



Incremental Klaviyo-attributed revenue

Revenue per recipient improvement

Flow revenue growth

Repeat-purchase improvement



Deliverability, unsubscribe and spam-complaint thresholds will act as guardrails so that revenue cannot be increased simply by aggressively
ing the list.



The exact baseline and measurement methodology will be agreed upon before the performance program begins.

title: Sales Licensing Manager – YouTube & Media (Remote)
description:
Company: KOPS | Amsterdam, Netherlands

Location: Philippines – Fully Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time, with the opportunity to become Full-Time

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 3:00 PM – 7:00 PM Manila Time (occasional overtime may be required)

Hiring: ASAP



About KOPS



KOPS is a growing media company based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, led by Jordi, one of the biggest content creators on YouTube. Our main YouTube channel has over 15 million subscribers, alongside our gaming channel with over 5 million subscribers.



We operate in the fast-paced world of YouTube, digital entertainment, and media, creating opportunities to expand our reach through strategic partnerships and content licensing.



We are looking for a talented Filipino Sales Licensing Manager to join our growing international team. This is an opportunity for an experienced sales professional who understands the YouTube and media industry, knows how to communicate with business partners, and has the ability to turn opportunities into successful deals.



About the Role



We need someone who can take ownership of our licensing sales process from start to finish. You will be responsible for managing incoming licensing inquiries, engaging with prospective clients, presenting our channels and content, conducting sales calls, negotiating agreements, and following through until contracts are signed.



This is not a purely administrative position. We need someone who is confident speaking with clients, understands the business they are selling into, and can independently move opportunities forward without constant supervision.



You will work directly with our licensing pipeline and use HubSpot to manage active deals, review client conversations, track upcoming calls, identify opportunities that need follow-up, and ensure that no potential deal is left unattended.



What You Will Do



You will manage our licensing inbox and respond to incoming inquiries, ensuring that potential partners receive timely and professional communication. You will review active opportunities in HubSpot, monitor upcoming calls, follow up with clients who have questions, and reconnect with prospects who have not yet made a decision.



You will lead sales conversations with potential licensing partners, confidently pitch KOPS's YouTube channels and content, explain our licensing opportunities, address client questions, and handle objections. You will be expected to understand what we offer and communicate its commercial value to prospective buyers and partners.



You will manage the entire sales cycle, from qualifying interested prospects and arranging meetings to conducting calls, negotiating commercial terms, coordinating contracts, and following through until the deal is closed. You will also maintain accurate records in HubSpot, update deal stages, document conversations, and ensure every active opportunity has a clear next step.



You will proactively identify opportunities to grow our licensing business, build relationships with relevant media companies and commercial partners, and help improve our sales processes and conversion rates. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and understands that consistent communication is essential to closing deals.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a candidate with extensive end-to-end sales experience and a strong background in YouTube, digital media, entertainment, content licensing, or a related industry. You should understand how the media business operates and be familiar with the commercial opportunities surrounding YouTube content and distribution.



You must have excellent written and spoken English and be comfortable leading professional conversations with international clients. You should be confident presenting offers, negotiating terms, handling objections, and persuading potential partners to move forward.



Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM platforms is highly desirable. You should know how to manage a sales pipeline, prioritize active deals, track follow-ups, and maintain accurate client records.



We need someone who is proactive, organized, commercially minded, and capable of working independently in a remote environment. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your own pipeline, identifying what needs to happen next, and acting without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.



Most importantly, you must know your line of business. We are looking for someone who already understands sales and the YouTube or media industry, rather than someone who needs to learn the fundamentals from scratch.



Work Schedule and Opportunity



This is a fully remote, part-time position with a regular schedule of Monday to Friday, from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM Manila Time. Occasional overtime may be necessary to accommodate client calls, negotiations, or important business opportunities.



As KOPS continues to expand, this position has the potential to transition into a full-time role for the right candidate. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and contribute to building a successful licensing operation.



We are looking to hire as soon as possible.



How to Apply



If you believe you have the experience, industry knowledge, and confidence to succeed in this role, please send your updated resume and a short video introduction to 
 with a subject line: Sales KOPS.



In your video, introduce yourself, explain your experience in end-to-end sales, highlight your background in YouTube or media, and tell us why you would be a strong fit for this position.



Please ensure your video is professionally recorded, with clear audio and appropriate presentation. Speak confidently and naturally, as if you were speaking directly to a potential client. Do not read from a script. We want to see your genuine communication skills, confidence, and ability to present yourself professionally.



Applications without a video introduction may not be prioritized.



If you are an experienced sales professional who understands YouTube and media, knows how to build client relationships, and can confidently turn opportunities into closed deals, we would love to hear from you.

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist – Ecommerce/DTC | Scripts, Briefs, Angles & Full-Funnel Testing
description:
About us

We are a growing ecommerce brand, and Meta Ads is our main acquisition channel. Our editors already produce the content. What we need now is the strategic mind who d
 what we make, for whom, why, and when to test it, and who turns those decisions into scripts and briefs our editors can execute. You will work closely with the founder and the editing team, and you will have real influence on the brand's creative direction.



The role

You will own creative strategy on Meta and turn it into execution. That means writing the scripts and creative briefs our editors work from every week. You will find new angles and avatars, stay ahead of what is working in the market, and build a testing process that consistently produces winners. We want someone who brings ideas, challenges assumptions and pushes innovation. We do not want someone who waits to be told what to do.



What you'll do



Study the niche in depth: Amazon reviews, Reddit, forums, comments, competitor ads and the Meta Ad Library, to uncover pain points, desires, objections and the customer's real language

Find and develop new avatars and angles, and keep a living angle bank mapped to funnel stage and awareness level

Plan creative across TOF, MOF and BOF, knowing what each stage needs and how it connects to the others

Track market trends, formats and hook styles, and spot what is worth adapting before it becomes saturated

Write ad scripts for every format we run (UGC, founder-led, demos, comparisons, voiceover, native-style content), covering hook variations, body, proof and CTA

Write detailed creative briefs for the editors: objective, avatar, angle, funnel stage, format, hook options, script, visual direction, references and what we are testing

Write copy for statics and carousels, including headlines, primary text and on-image text

D
 what to test, when, and why: new concepts vs. iterations, hook variations, format tests

Read performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, hook rate, hold rate, frequency, AOV, CVR) and turn insights into the next round of creative

Work directly with the founder on strategy, and with the editors on execution, reviewing their cuts and giving clear, actionable feedback



What we're looking for



Proven experience as a creative strategist for ecommerce/DTC brands on Meta Ads

Strong scriptwriting skills: you know how to write hooks that stop the scroll and scripts that hold attention and convert, adapted to each funnel stage

Experience writing clear, detailed creative briefs that editors can execute without guesswork

Deep knowledge of formats, hooks and creative structures that perform on Meta today (UGC, founder-led, demos, comparisons, statics, carousels, native-style content, and more)

Strong understanding of avatars, angles, awareness levels and funnel stages

Solid grasp of the numbers behind an ecommerce business: ROAS, CPA, breakeven ROAS, margins, AOV, CVR, and how creative performance affects profitability

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager: you don't need to be a media buyer, but you must be able to read an account and draw creative conclusions from it

A research-first mindset: you dig into reviews, Reddit and customer conversations before writing a single hook

Proactive and strategic: you bring ideas, propose tests and explain the reasoning behind them

Excellent written English and clear communication

A portfolio with real examples of scripts, briefs, angle docs or ads you strategized, ideally with results



Nice to have



Direct-response copywriting background

Experience with creative analytics or inspiration tools (Motion, Foreplay, Atria or similar)

Experience across multiple niches or brands



This role is not for you if



You are mainly a video editor or UGC creator, without strategy and research experience

You are a pure media buyer with no creative background

You only provide ideas or strategy decks and don't write the scripts and briefs yourself

Your experience is mostly in lead gen, local businesses or agency work outside ecommerce

You cannot show concrete examples of your work



Engagement

Ongoing collaboration. Hours and structure are flexible and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

title: Clipper/ video editor
description:
NOW HIRING: TikTok Content Editor / Virtual Assistant 



Position: Short-Form Video Editor & Viral Content Specialist

Location: (Remote)

Platform: TikTok, Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts



Job Description



I’m looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and highly motivated Video Editor / Virtual Assistant to help turn my TikTok LIVE streams into engaging, high-quality, viral-worthy short-form content.



I regularly host TikTok LIVE streams ranging from 1 to 8 hours long, covering everything from hilarious game shows and celebrity interviews to motivational conversations, business discussions, and Bible studies.







I will send over the full file of the video.

Your job is to take these streams, identify the BEST moments, and transform them into compelling short-form videos that have the potential to go viral.



YOU MUST HAVE YOUR OWN SOFTWARE AND SUBSCRIPTIONS to your own services TO EDIT THE VIDEOS! 



I’m not just looking for someone who knows how to cut videos. I need someone who understands storytelling, social media trends, human emotion, comedy, and what makes people stop scrolling.







Types of Content You’ll Be Editing



1. Comedy & Game Shows



* Identify hilarious moments, unexpected reactions, funny answers, and entertaining interactions.

* Capture moments that make viewers laugh, comment, and share.

* Understand comedic timing and how to edit clips for maximum entertainment.



2. Celebrity & Business Interviews



* Find powerful insights, memorable stories, surprising revelations, and valuable advice.

* Identify moments from conversations with actors, entertainers, entrepreneurs, and other high-profile guests.

* Turn meaningful conversations into clips that capture attention immediately.



3. Bible Studies & Faith-Based Conversations



* Identify powerful spiritual lessons, thought-provoking questions, and inspirational messages.

* Find moments that encourage reflection, meaningful discussion, and audience engagement.

* Edit clips while preserving the context and integrity of the message.



4. Motivational & Deep Conversations



* Recognize emotionally powerful, relatable, and inspiring moments.

* Identify statements that make people stop scrolling and think.

* Turn meaningful discussions about life, relationships, personal growth, and success into shareable content.



Your Responsibilities



* Review uploaded TikTok LIVE recordings ranging from 1–8 hours.

* Independently identify the strongest moments with viral potential.

* Select clips based on humor, emotion, entertainment value, educational value, and audience engagement.

* Edit engaging vertical videos (9:16) optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

* Add accurate, engaging captions, dynamic cuts, zooms, and appropriate visual effects. WHERE IT WOULD FIT BEST, no one to have captions and not to have captions no one to do dynamic zooms and when not to etc. 

* Create attention-grabbing opening hooks that encourage viewers to keep watching.

* Remove unnecessary pauses and dead air and distractions without losing important context.

* Understand when a clip should be funny, emotional, educational, inspirational, or thought-provoking.

* Organize and deliver completed clips consistently.



What I’m Looking For:



The most important skill is your ability to recognize a GREAT moment without me having to point it out.



You should have:



* Strong experience editing TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

* An excellent understanding of viral content and viewer retention.

* Strong English comprehension, including American humor, slang, and cultural references.

* The ability to understand emotional, serious, comedic, and inspirational conversations.

* Experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

* Strong attention to detail and excellent communication.

* The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Creativity and good judgment when selecting clips.



Experience editing podcasts, livestreams, interviews, or long-form content is a major plus.



What Success Looks Like



I want someone who can watch a four-hour livestream and recognize:



* The 15-second moment that could make thousands of people laugh.

* The 45-second conversation that could inspire someone to change their life.

* The unexpected celebrity response that people will want to share.

* The powerful Bible study discussion that sparks hundreds of comments.

* The business advice that makes viewers stop scrolling and save the video.



I want an editor who thinks like a content creator, not just someone who operates editing software.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. Links to 3–10 examples of short-form clips/videos you’ve edited.

3. Your experience working with long-form livestreams, podcasts, or interviews.

4. Your expected hourly rate or preferred payment structure.

5. Your availability and typical turnaround time.



Bonus: Tell me what you believe makes a short-form video go viral.



Final Note



I’m looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who is creative, reliable, and genuinely understands content.



This is an opportunity to work with a wide variety of content, including entertainment, celebrity interviews, comedy, faith, education, and motivation.



If you have an eye for moments that people can’t help but watch, laugh at, learn from, or share, I want to hear from you!

title: WEBSITE DESIGNER — Premium Tea, Spices & Lifestyle Brand
description:
ABOUT US



Penbrae & Co is a new premium brand based in Cardiff, Wales, UK. We import rare, single-origin teas and spices from the Upper Assam region of North East India and sell them direct to consumers and boutique retailers. Our brand is rooted in authenticity, heritage, and sensory experience — think artisan storytelling, not corporate e-commerce.



Every product we sell has a story: who grew it, where, how it was harvested and prepared. We want the website to tell those stories in a way that is immersive, non-linear, and human.



THE ROLE



This is not a standard e-commerce build. We are looking for a designer who can create an experiential, story-driven website — one that draws visitors in, lets them explore at their own pace, and makes purchasing feel like a natural conclusion to a journey rather than a transaction.



We are starting with a fixed-price project to build the complete, fully functional website. Once the site is live, we expect ongoing work — new products, seasonal content, social media assets, and further development — which we would offer project by project. As the business grows, there is a clear path to part-time and eventually full-time employment for the right person.



Key features we have in mind:



- Rich product storytelling — each product has its own narrative: the maker, the place, the process. We want this told through text, photography, and audio/video where appropriate.

- Non-linear navigation — visitors should be able to explore by story, by region, by product type, or by producer, not just by category.

- Audio and visual integration — ambient sound, short documentary-style video clips, and photography will be central to the experience.

- Seamless e-commerce — beautifully integrated purchasing that does not break the mood of the site.

- Mobile-first — the experience must work as well on a phone as on a desktop.



We are open to your approach. If you prefer Elementor, we can provide access to Astra Pro. But if you have a better solution — a custom theme, a headless build, a different page builder — we want to hear your thinking.



IDEAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



Essential:

- Strong portfolio of WordPress website design, ideally lifestyle, food, or storytelling brands

- Experience with e-commerce / WooCommerce

- Ability to integrate video and audio content into a web experience

- Eye for premium, editorial, immersive design — not template-heavy work

- Good English communication (written)



Highly desirable:

- Graphic design skills — brand assets, banners, editorial layouts, product photography treatment

- Experience designing non-linear or editorial-style navigation

- AI tools for design or content

- Social media management and content creation

- SEO and page speed optimisation

- Experience with subscription or membership plugins

- Interest in food, culture, travel, or documentary storytelling



HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following — applications without a portfolio or fixed-price quote will not be considered:



1. A brief introduction — who you are and why this role interests you

2. A portfolio link or examples of websites you have designed

3. Two or three examples from your portfolio that most closely match what we are describing — experiential, story-driven, or editorial websites with audio/visual elements. Please tell us briefly why you have chosen each one.

4. A fixed price to design and build the complete website as described

5. Your preferred tools, page builders or frameworks — and why you would choose them for a project like this

title: Part-Time Virtual Assistant for a Fly Fishing Marketing Agency (10–20 hrs/week)
description:
Hi there,



My name is Ben. I'm a brand designer with 10+ years of experience, and I run Good Drift, a marketing agency that works only with the fly fishing industry. Our clients are guides, outfitters, fly shops, lodges, brands, and conservation nonprofits. We help them get more bookings and sales, so they can spend more time on the water and less time worrying about marketing.



I'm looking for a part-time virtual assistant to help me grow the business. Good Drift is getting busier, and I need someone to take research, scheduling, and admin off my plate so I can focus on strategy and design for our clients.



That's where you come in.



What you'll do

Roughly in order of priority:

• Lead research. Research fly fishing lodges, outfitters, and shops that could become clients. Review and fill out the prospect lists our AI research tools produce, verify contact details, and prepare outreach for my review.

• Social media scheduling. Schedule posts for Good Drift's Instagram from our content calendar.

• Inbox and calendar. Sort
, flag what needs my attention, and book calls with clients and prospects.

• Meeting recaps and follow-up. Turn meeting notes into recap
s and tasks. You'll draft recaps and follow-ups for me to review, and send routine admin
s (scheduling, confirmations, reminders) from our templates on behalf of the Good Drift team.

• Pipeline and admin. Keep our sales pipeline and client records up to date, follow up on outstanding invoices, track deadlines, and keep our files organized.



I already have written SOPs (step-by-step processes) for almost all of this work, so you won't be guessing. I also want you to help improve those processes as you learn them.



Tools you'll use

• Todoist (tasks and projects)

• Bonsai (CRM and client records)

• Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets)

• Slack (team communication)

• Granola (meeting notes)

• Claude and other AI tools



You don't need to know all of these on day one, but you should be comfortable online and quick to learn new tools. Experience using AI tools in your work is a big plus.



Who I'm looking for

• A self-starter who takes initiative and doesn't wait to be told what's next

• A hard worker who follows instructions carefully, and asks when something is unclear instead of guessing

• Open to feedback, and willing to suggest better ways of doing things

• Personable and willing to help others

• Clear, confident written and spoken English

• An interest in fishing or the outdoors would be awesome, but it's not required



How we work

A good drift is when a fly floats naturally down the river, without dragging. That's how I want our work to feel: steady, calm, and unhurried. I'd rather you do fewer things well than rush through everything.



Most of my Good Drift work happens in the evenings US Central time, which is morning in the Philippines. I'll often leave tasks at the end of my day for you to pick up during yours, and I'd like a short Slack update from you at the end of each working day.



Hours, pay, and timeline

• Hours: 10–20 hours per week, with room to grow

• Pay: $5–6 USD per hour, paid weekly

• Trial: a paid 30-day trial so we can both see if it's a good fit

• Timeline: I'm accepting applications through Sunday, October 18. I'll d
 by Friday, October 23, and I'd like to start the trial the week of October 26.



I'm looking for a long-term team member. As Good Drift grows, I'd like your role to grow with it.



How to apply

Please send a short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself. Tell me about your background, your experience, and why this role appeals to you. I know being on camera isn't comfortable for everyone, and I'm not looking for polish. I just want to get a sense of who you are and how you communicate.



To show you've read this far, start your application message with the words "Good Drift."



Thanks, and I look forward to meeting you.



Ben

What we're looking for

Working experience with LinkedIn Ads, especially lead gen and B2B targeting

Remote, full-time

Works closely with the SEO, web/funnel, creative, content, and development tea
mbers



Compensation



Starting salary: USD 1,700 / month, with scope for increases based on performance and results





How to apply

Hiring process

Application review — we screen for real, verifiable results. No proof, no progress.

Screening call (~30 min) — intro, background, and a check on your coverage hours.

Skills interview (~60 min) — you'll walk us through a past campaign in detail and talk through how you'd approach a sample brief or account audit.

Practical task (short, paid) — a real-world exercise, e.g. auditing a sample account or outlining a campaign structure, so we can see how you actually think and work.

Offer & onboarding.

title: Amazon PPC Content Writer & LinkedIn Manager (US Amazon brands), daily posts
description:
About us

PPC Jumpstart is a small Amazon PPC agency based in Surrey, BC, Canada. Our clients are US brands selling on Amazon, mostly founders and owners doing $500K+ a year on Amazon. We manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, and our job is simple to say: grow their sales while keeping ACOS within their target.



I'm Vadim, the founder. I post on LinkedIn to reach US brand owners. I want one person to own a daily LinkedIn post on my profile: short, sharp, useful Amazon PPC posts that a busy US owner reads in 30 seconds and thinks "I should check that in my account."



The goal is to make my name the one US brand owners think of for Amazon PPC. Reach matters, but every post has to be useful to a business owner, not just to other PPC people. No "comment X for the PDF" tricks.



What you'll do every day

- Write one LinkedIn post a day (Mon–Fri) in our house template: a short, contrarian hook, one-line paragraphs, one simple comparison, one named Amazon report or tool, and a clear "what this means for your sales / ACOS / margin."

- Design the graphic for each post (single 4:5 image, sometimes a short carousel) in our brand style: navy, gold and our logo. Templates are provided.

- Find post ideas in Amazon Ads updates, my weekly interview notes, client results I give you permission to use, and my Loom audit recordings.

- Score every draft against our checklist before you send it to me. Below the bar, rewrite it.

- Send drafts to me for approval. Nothing goes live without my approval.

- Get approved posts live at 8:00 AM Pacific Time (US), and add the first comment with my booking link right after.

- Seven days after each post, open the post analytics and log where viewers came from (country/city) in our tracking sheet.

- Send a short Monday report: what went out, what scored well, which posts reached US viewers.



Must-haves

- Amazon Ads console fluency. You have worked inside Amazon Ads (as a PPC specialist, VA or account manager). You know Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, and you can read a search term report without help.

- You understand ACOS vs TACoS and can explain to a business owner why the lowest ACOS isn't always the best result.

- Strong US-business English. Short sentences, plain words, no filler. You can write for a US founder, not for other PPC specialists.

- Canva or Figma. You can follow a brand template exactly: colours, logo, spacing.

- LinkedIn native. You know how LinkedIn posts, carousels (PDF), first comments, scheduling and post analytics work.

- Reliable during US Pacific mornings. Posts go live at 8:00 AM PT, every weekday.

- Comfortable taking direct edits and rewriting fast.



Nice-to-haves

- You've ghostwritten LinkedIn posts for a founder or agency.

- Familiar with Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Business Reports, placement reports, Manage Your Experiments.

- You follow Amazon seller news and can explain an Amazon change in 3 lines.

- Basic video editing (short captioned clips).

- Google Sheets for simple logs.



Hours

- Must overlap with US Pacific mornings. Posts go live at 8:00 AM PT Mon–Fri.

- Philippines time: 8:00 AM PT = 11:00 PM PHT until Nov 1, 2026, then 12:00 AM (midnight) PHT after US clocks change (Nov 1 to March).

- Flexible part-time schedule. Time is tracked in Time Doctor.

- About 15–20 hrs/week to start.



Pay

$7–11 USD per hour, depending on skill and trial results. Hours tracked in Time Doctor.



Paid trial

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial, about 3 hours of work at your hourly rate, 48 hours to send it back. You'll write 3 posts from raw notes we give you and design 1 graphic. We'll pay for the trial whether or not we hire you.



How to apply

1. Put MARGIN FIRST as the first line of your application. Applications without it won't be read.

2. Answer in your own words, no AI (we'll know):

   - In 3 sentences, explain to a US brand owner why a low ACOS can hurt their sales.

   - What is the difference between ACOS and TACoS, and which one would you show an owner first? Why?

   - Which Amazon Ads reports have you used, and for what?

3. Send 2–3 LinkedIn posts or graphics you've written or designed (links or images).

4. Tell us your shift availability in Philippine time.

5. Optional: a 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English.

title: E-commerce Operations Manager – Suppliers (China & Germany) + Amazon FBA EU
description:
About us

We are a German home and lifestyle brand with 1,100+ SKUs, selling on Amazon FBA in Germany, France, Italy, Spain and the Netherlands plus German marketplaces. We buy from factories in China and from one manufacturer in Germany. A small founder team runs the business today. We are looking for one person who takes our day-to-day operations off the founders.



Full-time (40 h/week), long-term, independent contractor (monthly invoice). Salary EUR 1,400-1,600 per month depending on experience, paid via Wise. Review after 6 months.

Working hours must overlap European business hours and Chinese mornings: roughly 11:00-20:00 Philippine time.



WHAT YOU OWN

1. Suppliers. Daily communication in English with our factories in China and our manufacturer in Germany: purchase orders, production status, delays, order confirmations.

2. Purchase orders. Our in-house reorder tool calculates the quantities. You keep its data correct (lead times, MOQs, carton quantities, prices, open POs), check every PO proposal before it is released, send it, and check the supplier's confirmation line by line.

3. Quality. Production check-in before completion, pre-shipment inspection with our QC partner, claims when something is wrong.

4. Freight and import. Book freight with our forwarder, complete the documents, import via Rotterdam, reconcile receipts at our 3PL warehouse.

5. Amazon inbound. Execute FBA shipments from our 3PL and our German manufacturer (labels, box contents, pick-up), investigate shortages and file reimbursements. Our tool will soon create the shipments; until then you build them in Seller Central.

6. New suppliers. After we have chosen a sample, you take the supplier from contract to first order.

7. Routine tasks such as tracking uploads and marketplace returns, until they are documented and handed to an assistant.

A plus, not required: negotiating payment terms, Otto / Kaufland / eBay stock issues, Mandarin.



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have created Amazon FBA shipments yourself for 2+ years and recovered shortages through reimbursements.

- You have run purchase orders with Chinese factories for 2+ years: production follow-up, inspections, claims.

- You know Incoterms, FCL/LCL and import documents.

- You have owned operations for a brand with 100+ SKUs, not only executed tasks.

- You write precise English, work full-time for us only (no parallel clients), and can keep the working hours above.



HOW TO APPLY

Answer these questions in your own words. Applications without written answers are not read. Answers in a video only are not read.



1. Walk us through your last FBA inbound shipment from creation to receipt. What went wrong, and how did you fix it? (units, days, money)

2. Tell us about one claim you handled against a factory or a forwarder: what happened, the amount, the outcome.

3. A supplier tells you on Monday that production of our best seller is 3 weeks late. What do you do on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday?

4. PO CHECK. Below are 6 lines our tool proposed for a shower-curtain order. Simplified rules for this test:

- Designs are ranked by sales of size 180x200.

- Rank 1-10: all sizes may be ordered. Rank 11-25: only 180x200 and 120x200.

- Order in full cartons: 25 pieces per carton, 20 for 240x200 and 200x220.

- No sale and no stock for 365 days = inactive = order 0.

- Do not order if current stock already covers more than 12 months of sales.

title: Video Editor (Premiere Pro) – Full-Time, Long-Term, Remote
description:
Video Editor (Premiere Pro) – Full-Time, Long-Term, Remote



We run faceless documentary channels on YouTube. One is in English and one is in Arabic, and we upload every day. We’re hiring a full-time editor with a great eye.



What the job actually is

You won’t edit from scratch. Every day you get a Premiere Pro project that’s already about 80% built: the voiceover, visuals, archival footage, graphics, text, subtitles, sound effects and music are all placed and timed.



Your job is the last 20%, and it’s the part that matters most: polish it until it feels like a human with taste made it.



Tighten the pacing and fix any cut that feels off

Catch visuals that don’t match what the narrator is saying, and swap them

Make sure nothing feels repetitive, templated or like a slideshow

Sometimes find and add real footage when a scene needs it

You’re the last pair of eyes before upload, so if something looks wrong, you flag it



Taste matters most here. We can teach you our system. We can’t teach someone to feel when a cut is wrong.



What to expect



One finished video per day, every day

Full training from our current editor. You’ll learn the system step by step

Files are shared through Dropbox, and you leave your notes as markers in Premiere

You’ll keep your own notes on everything you learn. Corrections are given once, and you write them down the same day

Calm, story-driven content. No flashy TikTok-style editing



This is long-term, not a gig

We’re growing to 4 channels, all uploading daily. Every new channel will need an editor.



You need



A good eye for pacing, storytelling and detail

A reliable PC and internet connection, plus a Dropbox account

Good English

Honesty: you tell us when something is wrong and never hide it



Nice to have: experience with documentary or YouTube storytelling channels, and skill at finding footage.



**Pay:** $300/month



To apply: send your portfolio (documentary or YouTube work preferred) and one line on why taste matters in editing. Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test edit.

If you want short-term or easy, this isn’t for you. If you want to build something and grow with it, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Dental Social Media Manager + Instagram Lead Generation VA
description:
We are building a specialized social media marketing service for dental implant and cosmetic dentistry practices in the United States.



We need a Philippines-based social media specialist who can help us find dental clients and then fulfill the social media service once those clients are signed.



This is not only a lead-generation role. The right person will research prospects, create personalized outreach, develop content strategies, edit short-form videos, design posts, schedule content, and report results.



The business owner will handle discovery calls, proposals, pricing conversations, and live client meetings.



HOW THE ROLE WILL WORK



Before we sign clients, your time will primarily be spent on:



• Prospect research

• Personalized Instagram outreach

• Follow-ups

• Building content templates and sample strategies

• Creating our internal social media systems



As clients sign, more of your time will shift toward managing and producing their content. Hours can increase with each new client.



PROSPECTING RESPONSIBILITIES



• Find US-based dental implant and cosmetic dentistry practices

• Research each practice’s website and Instagram account

• Identify practices with valuable services but weak, inconsistent, or unclear social media positioning

• Find a genuine personalization point for every prospect

• Draft short, natural Instagram outreach messages

• Send approved messages or prepare them for the business owner to send

• Follow up with prospects who have not responded

• Track practices, contacts, messages, responses, and follow-up dates in Google Sheets

• Escalate interested prospects to the business owner

• Keep every prospect list free from duplicates

• Provide a short end-of-shift activity report



DENTAL CLIENT FULFILLMENT



For each signed dental client, you will help deliver a structured monthly social media service.



Responsibilities may include:



• Research the practice, its services, target patients, competitors, and local market

• Build a monthly Instagram and
 content strategy

• Create a 30-day content calendar

• Develop recording topics and simple shot lists for the dentist and staff

• Turn client-provided phone footage into professional short-form videos

• Edit approximately eight Reels per month

• Design approximately four educational carousels or image posts per month

• Write hooks, captions, calls to action, and hashtags

• Repurpose approved content between Instagram and

• Create Instagram Story ideas and supporting graphics

• Optimize profile wording, highlights, and consultation calls to action

• Schedule approved content through Meta Business Suite

• Organize client footage and completed assets in Google Drive

• Coordinate content approvals and revisions

• Monitor basic comments and engagement without giving medical advice

• Prepare a monthly report covering reach, engagement, inquiries, and consultation requests

• Recommend improvements based on performance



The dentist will provide raw footage, practice photographs, expertise, and properly authorized patient content. You will turn those materials into a professional and consistent social media presence.



You must not invent clinical claims, promise treatment results, give medical advice, or publish identifiable patient information without documented client approval.



IDEAL DENTAL PROSPECTS



• Dental implant or cosmetic dentistry practices in the United States

• Offer full-arch implants, All-on-X, smile makeovers, veneers, or full-mouth reconstruction

• Have strong expertise, technology, patient results, or reviews

• Could explain their value more clearly through social media

• Have an active website and legitimate local practice



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Excellent written English

• Experience managing Instagram and
 business accounts

• Short-form video editing experience

• Strong Canva design skills

• Experience writing social media hooks, captions, and calls to action

• Understanding of content calendars and brand consistency

• Experience with Instagram prospecting or online lead generation

• Strong internet research and personalization skills

• Comfortable using Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Meta Business Suite

• Able to manage deadlines and multiple client accounts

• Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions



PREFERRED TOOLS



• Canva

• CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

• Meta Business Suite

• Google Drive

• Google Sheets

• ClickUp, Trello, or another project-management platform



Healthcare, dental, local-business, or social media agency experience is strongly preferred.



IMPORTANT RULES



• No bots or automated mass messaging

• No purchased or recycled lead lists

• No generic copy-and-paste outreach

• No fake engagement or purchased followers

• Do not promise leads, patients, revenue, or treatment results

• Do not conduct sales calls

• Do not give medical advice through comments or direct messages

• Do not download, share, or publish patient information without approval

• Do not publish any content before client approval

• Do not contact duplicate prospects



COMPENSATION



$7–$10 USD per hour depending on experience and portfolio.



The position will begin at approximately 6–8 hours per week with a two-week paid trial. Hours and compensation can increase as we sign dental clients.

DENTAL SOCIAL MEDIA

title: Strategic Sourcing & Purchasing Specialist
description:
Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Specialist

US Construction & Restaurant Companies



About the Position



We are seeking an experienced, resourceful, and results-driven Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Specialist to support multiple US-based businesses in the commercial construction and restaurant industries.



Our companies include:



ADEP Group: A commercial specialty contractor specializing in demolition, asbestos abatement, and framing.



Sevmar Brands: A multi-location restaurant, hospitality, and food retail group.



Our primary goal is to **reduce purchasing costs while maintaining quality, reliability, and efficient operations.**



We are not looking for someone who simply places orders. We need someone who independently researches suppliers, negotiates competitive pricing, identifies alternatives, and continuously finds opportunities to save money. We like to order ahead of time on alibaba



### Key Responsibilities



**Construction Procurement**

- Source competitive pricing for demolition, asbestos abatement, and framing materials.

- Research suppliers for construction tools, PPE, equipment, consumables, and jobsite supplies.

- Compare pricing for equipment rentals, scaffolding, dumpsters, and other construction services.

- Request and evaluate quotations from multiple suppliers.

- Negotiate discounts, delivery costs, payment terms, and supplier agreements.

- Evaluate product specifications, availability, freight costs, and lead times.

- Identify alternative vendors and cost-saving opportunities.



**Restaurant & Hospitality Purchasing**

- Research and compare food distributors, ingredients, beverages, packaging, uniforms, cleaning supplies, and restaurant equipment.

- Identify lower-cost alternatives that meet existing quality standards.

- Negotiate supplier pricing and volume discounts.

- Compare vendor pricing across multiple restaurant locations.

- Monitor supplier price increases and identify opportunities for savings.

- Research restaurant equipment, furnishings, and operational supplies.



**Strategic Sourcing & Cost Analysis**

- Analyze existing vendor pricing and purchasing history.

- Obtain competitive quotes and prepare detailed comparisons.

- Build and maintain supplier databases and price comparison spreadsheets.

- Identify opportunities for consolidated purchasing and bulk discounts.

- Track historical pricing and supplier performance.

- Prepare weekly cost-saving reports and recommendations.

- Calculate potential savings based on comparable specifications, delivered costs, and purchasing volumes.



**Purchasing Administration**

- Maintain accurate vendor records, quotations, and purchasing documentation.

- Follow up with vendors regarding pricing, product availability, and delivery schedules.

- Coordinate with project managers and restaurant management.

- Develop purchasing SOPs, approval workflows, and vendor comparison templates.

- Organize purchasing records using Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.



### Qualifications



- Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain management.

- Experience working with US suppliers and vendors strongly preferred.

- Construction materials or restaurant purchasing experience preferred.

- Strong supplier research and negotiation skills.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to independently identify and present cost-saving opportunities.

- Comfortable communicating with US vendors and working US Eastern Time hours.

- Highly proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented.



### What We're Looking For



We want someone who thinks like an owner when evaluating purchasing decisions.



The ideal candidate does not accept the first price quoted. They proactively investigate alternatives, negotiate better terms, compare total delivered costs, and recommend improvements.



**Success will be measured by verified cost savings, purchasing accuracy, supplier reliability, and proactive follow-through.**



All purchase orders, contracts, vendor approvals, and financial commitments will remain subject to authorized US management approval.



### How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your resume and years of procurement experience.

2. Industries and product categories you have sourced.

3. Examples of cost savings or successful supplier negotiations.

4. Experience sourcing from US vendors and distributors.

5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

6. Confirmation that you can work US Eastern Time.

7. A brief explanation of how you would approach reducing purchasing costs for a US construction or restaurant company.



**Important:** Begin your application with **"STRATEGIC SOURCING"** to confirm that you read the full job description.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical sourcing and vendor comparison assessment.



We are seeking a dependable professional interested in a long-term opportunity supporting multiple growing US businesses.
